The motorhome is equipped with both a reverse camera and a rear-view mirror camera, making reversing, manoeuvring and parking considerably easier. Another important advantage is the three-way absorption fridge/freezer. Unlike the compressor fridges fitted to some later 2024-registered models, this fridge can operate on gas, 12V battery power or 230V mains electricity. It can also automatically select the most suitable power source, helping to keep the fridge and freezer running efficiently whether you are on a campsite, travelling or enjoying an off-grid or wild-camping trip. details.description:
After much deliberation, we have decided that the time has come to sell our 2023 AT Expedition 67 auto with pop top. It's done a bit over 26000 miles and we were the second owners, having purchased in November 2024. Brilliant van which has served our family of two adults and two kids really really well with its 4 belted seats and 4 berths.
As well as all the Autotrail factory standards, it has the shower room window, factory cab blinds and a second leisure battery, as well as a diesel heater which we added last year for the Scottish winters. I have also added extra insulation and a few other mods to shelves etc. The main modification though is the fixed bed frame I added across the back, giving large garage space beneath for paddle boards etc, comfier mattress, and no bed to set up each night. Nothing is drilled or fixed in place, meaning this bed can be completely removed and returned to factory layout with the bench seats prior to sale, or included in the sale if preferred.
Absolutely everything works exactly as it should and whilst there are a few signs of use, most notably on the pop-top canvas, it's a very well looked after and much loved van.
It has been serviced regularly and had an oil change in August 2026 along with a full habitation check which I'm more than happy to share with serious buyers.
I'm happy to arrange a fresh MOT and professional detail and wax prior to sale if the advertised price is met. Very happy to answer questions, informal chats, viewings etc.

Most campers this size make you choose: fixed bed OR storage, hot water OR simplicity. Rolo gives you all of it. The fixed double means no nightly bed-building, the Bobil Air Hybrid system feeds hot water to the taps and a Tetra fold down shower under the bed - perfect for washing off the adventures boots. Induction cooking, diesel heating, electric & diesel hot water: no gas bottles, no compromise.

- Fixed rear small double with custom mattress, reading lights, porthole windows oak liners
- Handcrafted olive sage shaker cabinetry, solid oak worktops with breakfast-bar return
- Slatted wood ceiling, painted walls, wood-effect LVT

- Bench seat with storage for the table
- Porta Potti stowed in the bench
- Roof fan and second opening skylight above the bed
- Sound deadened and fully insulated
- Hydraulic rams fitted to rear doors to keep them open on windy days
- Bed pods
- Folding handbrake lever
POWER & WATER
- 340Ah Roamer lithium (10-yr warranty), 300W solar, Victron MPPT
- Victron MultiPlus 2000W inverter - runs the hob off-grid, even a hairdryer
- Victron DC-DC + Lynx distribution; twin consumer units with double-pole RCBOs
- SavvyVan touchscreen - underslung fresh & waste tanks monitored and remotely drained
- 4kW Autoterm diesel heater with Comfort controller - true four-season van
- 240V hookup, sockets and USB points throughout
VEHICLE
Medium wheel  base with aircon, 2020 (70 reg), Bluetooth, manual, RHD. 5.90m long x 2.60m high. 3,500kg MAM with 2,800kg unladen (weighbridge verified) - a genuine usable payload. Wheeliams rear ladder.
Supplied with weighbridge certificate, smoke & CO alarms and our 24-month conversion warranty, backed by ongoing aftercare from a professional conversion company. Every van we build gets a name - Rolo is what you're viewing here.
Viewings welcome at our Northumberland workshop - and if Rolo isn't quite your spec, we build these to order.
Newbiggin-by-the-Sea, Northumberland |

details.description:
Grab a piece of history like no other. This vehicle is a head turner and a conversation starter.
Exceptionally low mileage - less than 5,000 miles. Drives like new.
Serious off-grid capability with BLUETTI Charger 1 engine charging, solar power and portable BLUETTI  energy storage.
A truly unique expedition-style 4x4 camper, built around an ex-MOD Land Rover 130 with exceptionally low original mileage. Originally supplied directly from UK Government Departments, the vehicle arrived with just 38km recorded and had been stored for approximately 10 years. It was originally fitted with military bomb-proofing, which was professionally removed as part of the conversion, retaining the character and heavy-duty engineering of its military origins.
The vehicle was recommissioned by Land Rover specialists, with new side doors, windscreen, rear lighting and other work completed before obtaining its MOT in June 2023. The chassis and camper structure have been carefully developed with durability and strength in mind.
The bespoke camper body sits on a purpose-designed and fabricated steel subframe. The habitation box uses a substantial aluminium profile frame with additional 40x40 triangulation added specifically for extra rigidity. The exterior is constructed from 2mm aluminium sheet, giving the body a strong, practical and highly distinctive finish.
Inside, the camper has 40mm insulation, marine-ply structural elements, Amtico wood-effect flooring and a clean, modern interior. It has been soundproofed using Dynamat throughout the doors, floor, walls, ceiling and under the bonnet.
Power is provided by a BLUETTI AC200MAX system with 2,048Wh LiFePO4 capacity and 2,200W inverter, supported by a 200W solar panel. The electrical system includes 12V lighting, reading lights and a roof skylight. There is also a 5G antenna and digital rear-view camera/mirror system.
The camper provides a comfortable fixed sleeping area, useful storage, kitchen facilities and a large rear access hatch. Roof rails and expedition storage boxes add further carrying capacity.
This is not a mass-produced motorhome. It is a genuinely bespoke, one-off build combining the toughness and heritage of an ex-MOD Land Rover with a modern, lightweight aluminium camper body. Ideal for touring, wild camping, overlanding or simply owning something completely different.
A comprehensive build manual documenting the vehicle's history, structural design, materials and equipment is available with the vehicle

Come and discover the all-new 2027 Swift Merlin 164 at Couplands Caravans, Louth.

details.description:
2017 Moto-Trek Leisure-Treka EB Elite – 2 Berth – Rear Washroom – Habitation Air Con
A superbly equipped 2017 Moto-Trek Leisure-Treka EB Elite, finished in metallic silver and offering an excellent 2 berth layout with a spacious front lounge and full-width rear washroom.
The Leisure-Treka EB Elite is a particularly clever panel-van conversion, giving you the ease of driving and parking of a van conversion while providing a level of space and equipment normally associated with a much larger motorhome.
Inside, the large front lounge features premium leather upholstery, long side seating, a forward-facing travelling seat and swivelling driver and passenger seats. The lounge provides plenty of space for relaxing or dining and converts at night to provide sleeping accommodation.
The well-equipped kitchen includes a full oven and grill, gas hob, sink with glass cover, large Dometic fridge/freezer, generous worktop space and plenty of fitted storage.
At the rear is one of the Leisure-Treka’s standout features – a full-width washroom with cassette toilet, shower, vanity/storage and opening window. This provides considerably more room and privacy than the compact washrooms normally found in panel-van conversions.
Specification includes roof-mounted habitation air conditioning, blown-air heating and hot water, large wind-out awning, electric entrance step, alloy wheels, towbar, reversing camera, cab air conditioning, cruise control, electric windows and mirrors, swivelling cab seats, rooflight, LED interior lighting, extensive overhead storage and multiple 230V/12V power points.
A very well designed and unusually high-specification motorhome that would make an excellent choice for a couple looking for a comfortable touring van without moving up to a larger coachbuilt motorhome.
Supplied with 12 Months RAC Warranty & Breakdown Cover, 12 Months MOT, engine service up to date and a full habitation check. Warranty upgrades of up to 3 years are available.
Part exchange welcome. Finance available subject to status.

details.description:
This 2027 Auto-Trail Expedition 66 is a compact and versatile two-berth van conversion, ideal for couples looking for a motorhome that is easy to drive while still offering the essential comforts needed for touring.
Measuring just 5.99 metres in length, the Expedition 66 is well suited to everything from weekends away to longer touring adventures. Its manageable dimensions make exploring towns, country roads and smaller campsites easier than in a larger coachbuilt motorhome.
Built on the Fiat Ducato, this model is powered by a 2.2-litre 140bhp engine and benefits from an automatic transmission. This combination helps make longer journeys and everyday driving more relaxed. The exterior is finished in smart Artense Grey, giving the Expedition 66 a contemporary appearance.
Inside, the layout has been designed specifically for two. The lounge creates a welcoming area in which to relax and dine during the day. At night, it converts to provide the sleeping accommodation, allowing the available interior space to serve more than one purpose.
The kitchen provides everything needed for meals on the road, including a hob, oven, grill and compressor fridge. Gas and electric heating and hot water provide additional comfort throughout the touring season.
For greater independence while travelling, there is also an on-board washroom with an integrated shower and cassette toilet.
This particular Expedition 66 also comes with the Premium Pack, adding to an already attractive specification.
With its 5.99m body length, two-berth layout, automatic transmission and comprehensive touring facilities, the Auto-Trail Expedition 66 is a strong option for couples who want the convenience of a van conversion combined with the comforts of a motorhome.

details.description:
The Auto-Trail V-Line 610 Sport is more than a campervan; it is a different way of enjoying your time. Designed for couples who would rather spend their weekends exploring than staying at home, it gives you the freedom to wake up somewhere beautiful, take the scenic route and make the most of every opportunity to get away.
This used 2017 two-berth has covered 33,500 miles and is powered by a 2.3-litre 130bhp diesel engine with a six-speed manual gearbox. The rear lounge is made for slow mornings and relaxed evenings, providing a comfortable space to enjoy breakfast, plan the day or simply watch the world go by before converting into sleeping accommodation at night. The kitchen is equipped with a full oven, gas hob and fridge freezer, while gas and electric heating keeps the interior cosy when you return from a day outdoors. A toilet and shower give you the freedom to travel more independently, wherever the road takes you.
When the weather is good, the awning creates an easy transition from indoor to outdoor living, giving you somewhere to sit, eat and enjoy those long summer evenings. Swivel cab seats, cruise control, TV aerial, towbar and practical storage add to its versatility, while alloy wheels, ABS brakes and twin airbags provide reassurance on the journey.
Registered on 8 May 2017 as NK17 FXM, this Auto-Trail V-Line 610 Sport is available from our Northamptonshire branch under stock number 25306. It is for those who want more from their weekends and holidays—less routine, fewer commitments and more freedom to simply go. Pack the essentials, choose a direction and make wherever you stop your home for the night.

202608205275997.title: Devon Firefly
searches: Campervans and van conversions (length from advert)

details.description:
The Devon Firefly is one of those campervans that makes you wonder why every van isn't designed this way. Based on the Ford Transit Custom, it gives you the driving manners and manageable dimensions of a car-derived van, but cleverly packs in everything you actually want when you disappear for the weekend — including four travelling seats, a proper kitchen, a washroom and two comfortable single beds.
And that's really the Firefly's appeal. It's a campervan you can genuinely use as an everyday vehicle, rather than something that only comes out when you're going away. At around 5 metres long, it remains remarkably easy to drive and park, while the 2019 Euro 6 Transit Custom gives you a modern, refined base vehicle with plenty of performance.
Inside, Devon's clever rear-kitchen layout makes excellent use of the space. The kitchen runs across the back of the van and provides a surprisingly generous amount of worktop, with a two-burner hob, sink and plenty of storage, while the clever built-in recesses for plates and mugs are a lovely example of Devon's attention to detail. Depending on the specification, there's also an oven/grill and either an 80-litre compressor fridge or three-way fridge.
Opposite the kitchen is something you don't always expect to find in a campervan this compact — a proper washroom with cassette toilet and privacy screen. It's a hugely useful feature, particularly when you're wild camping, travelling with children or simply don't fancy making a midnight dash across a campsite. The clever layout keeps the washroom tucked away when it's not required, so it doesn't dominate the living space.

Motorhome Marketplace are proud to present this beautiful 2-berth, 2-seatbelted, 2016 Peugeot camper conversion, based on a Boxer Professional 435 L4H2 van with a 2.2HDi 130PS engine, 6-spd man gearbox and just over 25,000 miles.
Converted from new, the 3rd such conversion by the owner, a professional cabinet maker. The build quality is a match (if not superior) to many of the big brand names, with American oak furniture and marine-standard two-tone faux leather seating throughout.
The modest exterior belies the luxury that awaits within, but it's still comprehensively equipped with Thule Omnister full-length wind-out awning (driveaway awning also included), LED lighting over the hab' door with an electric step, a gas BBQ connection with external gas grille included and the fresh water filler for the onboard tank. Once inside, the magic begins, with a premium quality feel to all fixtures and fittings. Besides the usual sink with dual gas hob, oven/grille, Waeco fridge/freezer, there are surprises like the cocktail cabinet, gloss black kitchen units with drawers containing storage baskets, sleek TV cabinet,  built-in Blaupunkt speakers, low level blue mood lighting which continues into a fully equipped washroom with Thetford toilet, shower, fold-away basin and built in  cabinet.
The large end lounge converts to 2 generous single beds or becomes a spacious dinette when the table is in use, which cleverly stores over the cab when not . Heating/hot water comes from the built in Propex system.
For peace of mind this camper comes with 12-months Autogard warranty.

Some campervans are fantastic once you're on holiday but feel like a compromise when you're driving them around at home.
The Auto-Trail V-Line 660 S is different.
At just under 6 metres long, it gives you the best of both worlds: compact, manoeuvrable and easy to park during the week, yet surprisingly spacious and well-equipped when Friday afternoon arrives and it's time to head for the coast, the mountains or the ferry to Europe.

Walk inside and you'll immediately see why the V-Line 660 S has such a loyal following.
The rear features two long opposing bench seats, each around 6ft 3in, creating a wonderfully sociable lounge area.
During the day, it's the perfect place to sit with a coffee, stretch out after a day's exploring or enjoy dinner when the British weather decides that eating outside isn't happening!
At night, the clever seating arrangement transforms into either two single beds or one large double, giving you genuine flexibility depending on how you prefer to sleep.
And because the cab seats swivel around, the front of the van becomes part of the living space too — creating a surprisingly open lounge/diner without needing a huge motorhome.

Compact Twin‑Bed Touring With Modern Expedition Styling
Overview
The Auto‑Trail Expedition 68 is a smart, compact van conversion designed for customers who want practicality, comfort, and modern styling in a manageable footprint. Powered by the Fiat 140BHP Diesel Manual and finished in the sleek Artense Grey, this model delivers excellent driving performance with a versatile twin‑bed layout ideal for couples or solo travellers.
The Expedition range is known for its clean, modern interior, clever storage solutions, and lightweight touring feel — making the 68 a superb choice for both first‑time buyers and seasoned motorhome owners.

Fiat Ducato 2.2L Diesel – 140BHP Manual
Artense Grey exterior
2 Berths / 2 Travel Seats
Twin single beds with central walkway
Expedition interior with modern soft furnishings
Fully equipped kitchen: hob, sink & fridge
Compact washroom with toilet, shower & storage

LED lighting throughout
Lightweight, easy‑to‑drive 6m van conversion

KIA PV5 “i-Camper” by Wellhouse

The Kia PV5 is one of the most talked-about compact electric vans to be launched in recent years—and it is easy to see why.
Many electric vehicle brands are still relatively unknown, but everyone knows Kia. The PV5 comes with Kia’s renowned seven-year warranty, offers an excellent driving range and is compact enough to use as an everyday vehicle. It looks fantastic, drives superbly and costs thousands of pounds less than many comparable electric vans.
If you haven’t driven a Kia PV5 yet, we recommend taking one for a test drive—you may be very pleasantly surprised!
Our new Kia PV5 “i-Camper” is built on the higher-specification Plus model and comes with the larger 71.2kWh battery, metallic paint and heat pump included in the price.
The sliding rear seat system has been fully tested in Germany. The front seat swivels have also been tested in Germany with the campervan roof frame fitted (as far as we are aware no one has done this level of testing)
Although the campervan can use the Kia’s main battery through its Vehicle-to-Load system, it will also have a separate lithium leisure battery, solar panel and mains hook-up. This means you will not need to rely solely on the vehicle’s propulsion battery when staying on a campsite.
When connected to the campervan mains hook-up, the system will also be capable of slow-charging the vehicle battery.
Remember, the price includes the larger long-range battery, higher-specification Plus model, metallic paint, heat pump and complete Wellhouse “i-Camper” conversion.
We have over 30 on order of which half are pre sold already but all colours available.
Please note that some of the conversion photographs currently shown are AI-generated concept images or images of our similar Toyota Proace conversion. Our demonstration Kia PV5 is now back at Wellhouse with its elevating roof fitted and the conversion is underway. The final specification may be subject to minor changes.

details.description: Motorhome Depot are pleased to present this excellent 2024 Sunlight V66 Adventure 2-berth,4-belt panelvan motorhome. Based on the Fiat Ducato , it is powered by the reliable 2.2 140BHP engine and 6-speed gearbox. Having only covered 6900 miles with 1 owner, this motorhome will come with a habcheck in June 2026 and a FSH so the next owner can have complete peace of mind.The GVW is 3500kg so it can be driven on a standard UK licence and is only 6.6m long so is very easy to handle.It is worth noting that this van was very highly specced at manufacture by the present owner at a cost of £5k.These extras include - carpets, 2 x leisure battery ,external BBQ point , upgrade Pioneer DAB unit with steering controls, 12v Maxxair Maxxfan, Sentinel Ultimate S5 tracker with lifetime subscription , Avtex 5G router , Awning , Reverse camera , Solar Panel, Vanbitz Battery master which keeps the battery topped up and Gaslow LPG System. Being the Adventure Model, the spec also includes Insulated tanks, heated floors and alloy wheels.On entering the van via the electric step, you are in the lounge area. The forward facing seats have 2 passenger belts and sit beneath the TV bracket. Both front seats swivel to provide a comfortable dining area for up to 4 people.Moving towards the back of the van, we have the small kitchen galley which has plenty of storage space as well as a 2 ring gas hob and small oven and grill located underneath. The off-grid electrical setup is a standout feature, built around a full Victron system including a MultiPlus-II 5500W inverter charger, Cerbo GX monitoring, Orion XS charging, 620Ah lithium battery bank, 120Ah mains charger and 360W solar array. Heating and hot water come from a Truma Combi 4, plus a Truma Saphir air conditioning unit.
Further features include cab air conditioning, cruise control, reversing camera, DAB radio, Bluetooth, WiFi, TV system, refillable gas tank, and uprated front/rear springs and shocks.
A rare, high specification motorsport conversion with serious off-grid capability, premium finish and practical paddock design, within the desirable 3,500kg licence category.

details.description:
The Etrusco CV 640 PB is a 6.36-metre camper van designed for flexible touring, combining compact external dimensions with a smart, adaptable interior. Built on a Fiat Ducato chassis, it offers a good balance between everyday drivability and comfortable living for longer trips.
Finished in Expedition Grey, the exterior has a clean, modern appearance, while the interior trimmed in Emilia cloth provides a practical and comfortable living space with a contemporary feel.
A standout feature of this model is the electric height-adjustable rear double bed, which significantly enhances versatility. The bed can be raised or lowered as needed, allowing the rear area to be adapted for different uses. When lifted, it creates a large garage space capable of accommodating bicycles or even a small motorbike, making it ideal for active travel and outdoor gear. Lowering the bed restores a comfortable sleeping area without requiring any complex setup.
The layout includes a transverse rear bed area, a central kitchen with hob, sink, and fridge, and a compact washroom with toilet, basin, and shower. At the front, swivelling cab seats integrate with the dining area to form a sociable lounge space.
Storage is well distributed throughout, with overhead lockers and cleverly designed compartments that maximise usable space. Overall, the CV 640 PB offers a practical, modern camper van solution, with the added benefit of a configurable rear garage thanks to the electric raisable bed—ideal for transporting bikes, a motorbike, or other large equipment while maintaining comfort on the road.

202604101437283.title: Malibu Relax 640 LE R
searches: Campervans and van conversions (length from advert)

details.description:
The Malibu Relax 640 LE R from Malibu is a well-built campervan based on the Fiat Ducato, designed for comfortable touring while staying compact at around 6.4 m in length.
Inside, it has a practical layout with two single beds at the rear that can be used separately or combined. The middle section includes a compact kitchen and a washroom with a space-saving shower, while the front lounge provides a seating and dining area. The layout allows easy movement through the van without needing to constantly convert spaces.
The main systems are simple to operate, with a central control panel for water, power, lighting, and heating. It includes onboard fresh and waste water tanks, a leisure battery, and a Truma heating system that provides both warmth and hot water, making it suitable for use in different seasons.
Storage is one of its key strengths. There are deep kitchen drawers, overhead lockers, under-bed compartments, and additional storage built into the floor. The rear area offers enough space for larger items, making it practical for longer trips.
The exterior is usually finished in white, giving it a clean and understated look. An awning is typically optional but commonly fitted, creating a sheltered outdoor area. A TV bracket can also be installed inside, usually near the lounge, with a swivel arm so the screen can be viewed from both the seating area and the rear beds.
Overall, it offers a good balance of comfort, storage, and ease of use in a manageable campervan size.

details.description:
If you’re looking for a campervan that’s easy to drive but still feels comfortable to live in, the Bailey Endurance E62 is well worth a closer look.
At just under six metres, it’s manageable on the road and simple to park, but step inside and it doesn’t feel tight or restrictive. For couples who want flexibility without jumping up to a larger motorhome, this layout makes a lot of sense.
Up front, the lounge area is light and sociable with swivel cab seats and a flexible table set-up. It’s a space you’ll actually use, morning coffee, planning the next stop, or just putting your feet up after a long walk.
At the rear, the lounge converts into a generous double bed. It’s straightforward to set up and doesn’t involve complicated mechanisms. You can leave it made up if you prefer, or keep the space open during the day. It’s practical, and sometimes practical wins.
The kitchen gives you what you need for real touring. There’s a 90-litre compressor fridge that performs well off grid, a two-ring gas hob, sink and sensible storage. Opposite, the compact washroom includes a proper onboard shower and electric flush toilet. It’s designed to be usable rather than decorative.
Where the Endurance range really stands out is its year-round capability. With Grade III insulation, Truma heating and hot water, solar support and twin leisure batteries, this is a campervan you can use beyond summer weekends. Early spring breaks and autumn trips feel just as realistic.
As you’d expect from Bailey, build quality feels solid and reassuring throughout, we’ll happily talk you through whether the E62 or E65 genuinely suits how you travel. There’s no one-size-fits-all answer.

At the rear, the spacious lounge and dinette area provides two long side benches that are perfect for stretching out and unwinding at the end of the day. 202603130668589.title: Bailey Endurance E62
202603130668589.subTitle: - 2026 - AUTO - LOWEST PRICES EVERYDAY - PRICE PROMISE! 2.0
searches: Campervans and van conversions (length from advert)

details.description:
If you’re looking for a campervan that’s easy to drive but still feels comfortable to live in, the Bailey Endurance E62 is well worth a closer look.
At just under six metres, it’s manageable on the road and simple to park, but step inside and it doesn’t feel tight or restrictive. For couples who want flexibility without jumping up to a larger motorhome, this layout makes a lot of sense.
Up front, the lounge area is light and sociable with swivel cab seats and a flexible table set-up. It’s a space you’ll actually use, morning coffee, planning the next stop, or just putting your feet up after a long walk.
At the rear, the lounge converts into a generous double bed. It’s straightforward to set up and doesn’t involve complicated mechanisms. You can leave it made up if you prefer, or keep the space open during the day. It’s practical, and sometimes practical wins.
The kitchen gives you what you need for real touring. There’s a 90-litre compressor fridge that performs well off grid, a two-ring gas hob, sink and sensible storage. Opposite, the compact washroom includes a proper onboard shower and electric flush toilet. It’s designed to be usable rather than decorative.
Where the Endurance range really stands out is its year-round capability. With Grade III insulation, Truma heating and hot water, solar support and twin leisure batteries, this is a campervan you can use beyond summer weekends. Early spring breaks and autumn trips feel just as realistic.
As you’d expect from Bailey, build quality feels solid and reassuring throughout, we’ll happily talk you through whether the E62 or E65 genuinely suits how you travel. There’s no one-size-fits-all answer.

details.description:
The Etrusco CV600 BB is a compact 5.99-metre campervan designed for travellers who want maximum versatility in a manoeuvrable van-conversion layout. Built on the trusted Fiat Ducato platform, it combines modern driving comfort with a smart, space-efficient interior that’s ideal for couples, small families, or adventure-focused travellers.
Inside, the CV600 BB features a clean, modern design with warm decor, quality materials and thoughtful ergonomics. The highlight of the layout is its TWO double bunk beds at the rear, offering flexible sleeping for up to four people. The lower bed can fold or lift to create a large storage area, perfect for transporting bikes, sports equipment or bulky luggage. The top bunk bed can also be removed. The front diner can also convert into an extra berth.
The central living area includes a practical dinette with swivel cab seats, creating a comfortable space for dining, working or relaxing. The compact kitchen offers everything needed for travel cooking, including a two-burner hob, sink, fridge and well-organised storage.
Opposite the kitchen sits a fully equipped wet-room bathroom with toilet, shower and practical shelving — proof that you don’t need a large motorhome to enjoy full facilities on the road.
With an overall height around 2.7 m and a slim 2.05 m width, the CV600 BB is easy to drive through cities and rural areas alike, while still providing 1.90 m of interior headroom. Heating and insulation are designed for all-season touring, making it suitable for year-round adventures.
Compact, capable and cleverly configured, the Etrusco CV600 BB offers an impressive balance of comfort, sleeping capacity and smart storage — all within a true “go-anywhere” campervan footprint.

Dormobile Renaissance Peugeot Boxer – 4 Berth Luxury Camper
Premium Comfort Meets Practical Design
The Dormobile Renaissance represents luxury motorhome living at its finest. Built on the powerful Peugeot Boxer 165BHP 2.0HDi platform with a smooth 6-speed gearbox, this 4 berth motorhome combines exceptional build quality with thoughtful features throughout.
Step inside to find a fully equipped kitchen featuring a 3-burner gas hob, microwave, single sink with splashback, and a generous 78-litre 12V fridge with freezer. The PowerDock system keeps all your devices charged, while ample worktop space makes meal preparation effortless.

Outside, the fitted Thule 3.0m awning with lighting extends your living space, while alloy wheels, reverse camera, and electric entrance step add premium touches. HEKI roof lights over front and rear areas flood the interior with natural light.

Ready for Adventure

ROLLER TEAM AUTO-ROLLER 259M
FRENCH BED | AUTOMATIC | SOLAR | WIFI
Enjoy the freedom to explore in the Roller Team Auto-Roller 259M, a practical and well-equipped motorhome offering comfortable accommodation, a clever layout and excellent touring facilities.
Designed for relaxing holidays and extended adventures, the Auto-Roller 259M combines a welcoming living area with a well-appointed kitchen, dedicated sleeping accommodation and useful storage throughout.
The fixed French bed provides a comfortable and convenient sleeping area without the need to convert the lounge every evening. The swivel cab seats help create a sociable living space, making it ideal for relaxing after a day of exploring.
The fully equipped kitchen includes a gas hob, oven and grill, sink with mixer tap and compressor fridge, giving you everything needed to prepare meals while away. The washroom features a cassette toilet, sink and hot and cold shower, providing the convenience of home wherever your travels take you.
Comfort is well catered for with double glazing, electric and gas heating, cab blinds, flyscreens and a large rooflight that helps create a bright and airy interior.
For added independence, the specification includes solar panels, a leisure battery, fresh and waste water tanks and an LPG refillable gas bottle. An external gas BBQ point, external shower point and external 230V socket make outdoor living even more enjoyable.
Further highlights include alloy wheels, cruise control, reversing convenience from heated mirrors, an awning, TV aerial, WiFi, external lighting, colour-coded bumpers and an awning light.
FRENCH BED | ALLOY WHEELS | SOLAR PANELS | WIFI | AWNING | GAS HOB | OVEN & GRILL | COMPRESSOR FRIDGE | CASSETTE TOILET | HOT & COLD SHOWER | DOUBLE GLAZING | GAS & ELECTRIC HEATING | REFILLABLE LPG | EXTERNAL BBQ POINT
Supplied with a minimum 12-month UK & European Roaming Warranty. T&C's apply.
A superbly equipped motorhome for anyone looking to enjoy comfortable touring, greater independence and memorable adventures on the open road.

Dometic 3-way powered fridge with freezer box, upper/lower cabinets to store your holiday provisions.The Front Dining Area:  two forward facing seats, both with three-point seatbelts. Both front cab seats swivel to face the extending dining table, upper aircraft style storage lockers & side window.The Main Feature: Rear lounge, which can also be accessed from the rear doors, with two parallel sofas that easily convert to a large double bed. Relax in the lounge with the rear doors open, watch the sunset & world go by.The Washroom: A shower tray, shower handset & curtain. The automatic transmission takes the effort out of driving, particularly in traffic, on busy roads and during long-distance journeys. Cruise control and a speed limiter make motorway driving far more relaxed, while air conditioning keeps the cab cool and comfortable when temperatures rise. Receive music and calls with ease with steering wheel controls, while the reversing camera takes much of the stress out of parking and manoeuvring the motorhome.But the real appeal of the Adamo 69-4 is the amount of living space and thought that has gone into the interior.The rear washroom is particularly impressive and gives you the feeling of having a proper bathroom wherever your travels take you. The huge washroom incorporates a large separate shower, meaning you don’t have to compromise on comfort or share a cramped wet-room space. There is a Thetford cassette toilet with electric flush, a wash basin with mixer tap, a large mirror and two dedicated bathroom storage units. Add to this the enormous cupboard for clothing and personal belongings, and you have an exceptional amount of storage space throughout the rear of the vehicle.The well-appointed kitchen is equally impressive and gives you everything you need to enjoy proper meals away from home. The generous automatic energy-selecting fridge freezer provides plenty of space for fresh food and drinks, while the dual-fuel hob gives you an electric hotplate alongside three gas burners. The gas oven and grill mean you can cook just as you would at home, making longer stays away far more enjoyable. The lounge is where this Bailey really comes into its own. Two comfortable side-facing sofas, finished in attractive grey upholstery, create a welcoming and spacious living area where you can relax after a day of exploring. The large extendable dining table gives you plenty of room for meals, games or entertaining, and when the cab seats are swivelled around, the lounge comfortably accommodates up to six people. It is a genuinely sociable space rather than simply somewhere to sit.The clever design also means you don't lose valuable travelling capacity. Hidden beneath the lounge sofas are two forward-facing belted travel seats, giving four belted travelling seats in total. This makes the Adamo ideal for couples who want additional space, as well as families or friends travelling together.When it is time to sleep, the lounge sofas convert into a comfortable double bed, while the electric drop-down bed above provides another double sleeping area. This gives the motorhome comfortable sleeping accommodation for up to four people without compromising the living space during the day. The electric drop-down bed is particularly convenient, allowing you to create a generous sleeping area quickly and easily.Outside, the benefits continue. The large rear garage provides valuable additional storage for bikes, outdoor furniture, sporting equipment, luggage and all the other essentials you may want to take on your travels. This means you can enjoy the freedom to pack properly without filling the living area with equipment.The fitted solar panel is another excellent touring feature, helping to keep the leisure battery topped up and giving you greater freedom when staying away from campsites and mains electricity. Combined with the motorhome's generous storage and self-contained facilities, it gives you the opportunity to enjoy more independent touring and spend longer enjoying quieter, more remote locations.When you want to relax

2026 Pilote V630S
The V630S has been designed to offer maximum flexibility, with particular attention paid to the sleeping area.
Thanks to its clever system of modular bunk beds, it can be quickly adapted to suit the needs of families, couples, or solo travellers.
Double bed, twin beds, single bed with large storage space, or retractable upper bed – each configuration allows for optimal space use without compromising comfort.
At 6.36 m in length, with smart interior layout and high modularity, the V630S is the ideal travel companion for those seeking freedom without sacrificing practicality.
It features convertible bunk beds and an adjustable upper bed to suit all travel configurations.
Its removable storage cases replace overhead cabinets, offering practical and quick storage.
The through-loading garage space accommodates bikes and bulky equipment with securing rings.
The fully opening bathroom ensures comfort and space, even in the great outdoors.
The Lounge:
The V630S offers a welcoming, well-designed lounge area, where the swivel cab seats and forward-facing bench create a pleasant space for sharing meals or relaxing with up to four people.
The adjustable table adapts to different times of the day, and the large windows provide abundant natural light, enhancing the feeling of space.
The Bedroom:
Compact yet fully equipped, the kitchen features a large-capacity fridge, a two-burner stove, a functional sink, and clever storage solutions.
Positioned at the center of the vehicle, it allows for easy cooking while maintaining smooth circulation throughout the living area.
The Kitchen:
At the rear, the bedroom stands out for its high modularity. The bunk beds can be configured to suit your needs: as twin beds, a double bed, or a single bed with generous storage space underneath. The upper bed, equipped with a slatted bed base and independent mattress, can comfortably accommodate one or two people. An ideal setup for families or travelers seeking flexibility and comfort.
The Bathroom:
The fully opening bathroom combines a shower, sink, and toilet in an optimized space, with no compromise on comfort. Designed for daily convenience, it ensures a pleasant experience even on longer journeys.
The Garage:
Lastly, the rear garage offers true through-storage space. Accessible across the full height and width of the vehicle, it's equipped with tie-down rings for safely transporting bikes, scooters, or bulky gear. Seamlessly integrated, it makes the V630S a travel companion that’s both practical and versatile.

details.description:
This is an exceptional opportunity to own a meticulously maintained 2020 IH Motorhome N680CRL. Known for luxury British craftsmanship, IH Motorhomes are hand-built to the highest standards, offering a premium feel, clever space utilization, and ultimate comfort on the road. Whether you are planning weekend getaways or extended touring adventures, this rear-lounge model provides a bright, airy living space by day and a comfortable sleeping arrangement by night.
The quality can be seen throughout with hand-finished cabinetry crafted using high-grade lightweight hardwoods, featuring solid fixtures, soft-close drawers and robust hinges designed to withstand the rigours of the road without rattles. Bespoke upholstery stitching, seamless worktop finishes, and carefully concealed hardware showcase a level of luxury and durability rarely found in standard campervans.
This high quality motorhome features a spacious rear U-shaped lounge which converts quickly into a large double bed (or two singles). The kitchen is fully equipped with a gas hob, oven/grill, microwave, compressor fridge/freezer and sink with sleek modern worktops. There is a well-designed washroom featuring a cassette toilet, integrated shower, and washbasin. It also equipped with Truma blown-air heating and hot water system for year-round touring comfort. Premium fabrics and half leather is used throughout. As you would expect there is a high level of equipment including Cab Air Conditioning, 4m Awning, Multi Media System, Reverse Camera, Cruise Control, WiFi and Tow Bar.
Owning an IH Motorhome is more than just having a vehicle for travel; it is an investment in bespoke British craftsmanship and rare individuality. Because IH models are hand-built in limited numbers, they offer a level of exclusivity and attention to detail that sets them completely apart from standard campervans. Combining uncompromising build quality, timeless interior design, and effortless road comfort, this N680CRL represents a truly elite touring experience for the discerning owner.

details.description:
As the name suggests, the Fusion range is intended to represent a halfway house between Continental design and UK spec levels.
In the cab there is a reversing camera, which comes as standard on Fusion models. This also includes a DAB radio, cab blind.
All Fusions come with a minimum of four travel seats. The two in the rear here are easily assembled by removing part of the dinette seat. There’s plenty of legroom and passengers shouldn’t feel boxed in – there is a large window. They can even keep mobiles charged, thanks to USB ports positioned under the locker.
The front lounge area is dominated by a large table that slides left, right backwards and forwards, to allow everyone easy access.
The area is very well lit, not just from the large sunroof bringing in daylight from the cab and the big window. Under the drop-down bed, McLouis has installed a panel that includes LED downlighters.
The 330 is only 6.49m long, so it’s good that McLouis has managed to include a rear lounge that can seat at least six occupants.
When the table is folded back, there is plenty of room here. Folded out, it is a good size.
Once again, there is a clever LED panel underneath the drop-down bed, and those on the nearside might even benefit from the light that is shed by the two spotlights, which have been angled for the bed when it is in the lowered position.
The McLouis Fusion 330 really shows its Continental origins in the kitchen. Here, you get a two-burner gas hob, which is positioned side-on. This is, of course, potentially space-saving, you also get an extractor fan.
The sink is large, and the space is lit by a strip light and a backlit splash back. A Thetford Duplex combined oven/grill is fitted as well as a large fridge.
There is a bit of a step up into the 330’s washroom, but considering it is centrally located on only one side of the vehicle, it’s good to see that you get a separate shower compartment, which is formed by opening out the concertina screen that shuts off the built-in handbasin.
Includes additional 1 year roaming habitation warranty. *T&C's apply.

Configured as a 2 berth with 4 travelling seatbelts, the V5 is correctly registered as a camper and the MOT is valid until July 2027.The layout has been cleverly designed to make excellent use of the available space. Up front, both cab seats swivel to face the dining table and additional seating, creating a comfortable and sociable lounge and dining area. This provides a great space for relaxing, dining or entertaining without having to compromise the rear lounge and sleeping area.The rear of the motorhome features a spacious U-shaped lounge, providing another comfortable and versatile living space with plenty of seating. When night falls, this easily converts into a generous king-size bed, offering a particularly spacious sleeping arrangement.One of the major highlights of this motorhome is its comprehensive off-grid electrical system. A substantial 300Ah lithium leisure battery is supported by 240W of solar panels, while a powerful 3000W inverter allows you to run 230V appliances when away from mains hook-up. The van also benefits from electric hook-up for campsite use, providing genuine flexibility whether you're staying on a fully serviced site or heading away from the crowds.The kitchen area is well equipped for life on the road, featuring a 65-litre under-counter fridge/freezer and induction hob. There is a good amount of storage throughout the living area, with further useful storage available in the rear boot area. Provision has also been made for storing a camping toilet.Entertainment and connectivity are catered for with a 19-inch smart TV and Apple CarPlay/Android Auto, making longer trips and evenings away all the more enjoyable.Externally, this Sprinter has been given a purposeful and adventure-ready appearance. It sits on all-terrain Rogue alloy wheels and benefits from a roof rack, rear wheel carrier and rear ladder. A Fiamma F45S 4-metre wind-out awning provides a substantial outdoor living area, making it ideal for longer stays.Further features include a Scorpion immobiliser, electric hook-up cable and levelling ramps, which are included with the sale.Overall, this is a distinctive and highly capable Mercedes-Benz Sprinter motorhome, offering a level of off-grid capability that would suit anyone looking to travel independently. Introducing the Brand New 2027 Auto-Trail Expedition 68, a highly sought-after campervan that is built to the latest standards and designed for modern adventure. Constructed on a reliable Fiat Ducato 2.2 litre 140 bhp engine, this particular model has been upgraded to the new 8-speed automatic gearbox for an even smoother driving experience. It stands out with a dinette at the front, and a fixed upraised double bed at the rear, creating a huge garage underneath with plenty of storage space.
New for 2027, this Expedition 68 includes the Premium Pack and the Lifestyle Pack. The Premium Pack includes a Pioneer 9" touchscreen DAB radio with Apple Carplay/Android Auto, an integrated colour reversing camera, and pleated cab blinds to the front, drivers, and passenger side windows. The Lifestyle Pack includes a wind out awning, an electric habitation entrance step, a retractable fly screen, an exterior BBQ point, a removable carpet set, a 21.5" Avtex Smart TV, a TV aerial point with 12V power supply, and 5G ready portable motorhome Wi-Fi.
This 2 berth/4 belts model is a lesson in intelligent design. The generous-sized rear double bed provides a permanent sleeping arrangement, and this clever layout allows room for bulky gear. The nearside kitchen is surprisingly large for a campervan conversion and comes fully equipped with an extending worktop, a grill, oven, 2-gas hob, sink, and a fridge freezer. The washroom is a practical wetroom-style with a clever drop-down sink to maximise space when showering. The front dinette houses 2 additional traveling belts with the new style table with integrated cup holders.
The Expedition 68 is well-equipped for modern adventure. It comes standard with stylish Alloy Wheels, a Thatcham CAT 5 tracking system, and a 200W Solar Panel. Your next great escape awaits. Get in touch with our expert Sales Team here at Don Amott Leisure for further information on this exciting Brand New 2027 Auto-Trail Expedition 68.

The well-equipped rear kitchen includes an oven/grill, combi hob, microwave and fridge with ice box, along with excellent storage, making it perfectly practical for everything from a quick breakfast to a proper evening meal.
The washroom is a particular highlight, featuring a clever swing-wall shower that creates a fully enclosed shower cubicle when required. Combined with Truma Combi heating and hot water, it provides genuine comfort and convenience whatever the season.
This Bourton is exceptionally well equipped, including solar panel, underslung LPG tank, awning, external BBQ point, external 230V socket, digital TV aerial and onboard WiFi. Driving is made easy with cruise control, electric and heated mirrors, electric windows and a reversing camera.

2027 Roller Team Kronos Compact 665 Automatic – Built for Adventure, Designed for Easy Touring
Some motorhomes are compact because they have to be. The 2027 Roller Team Kronos Compact 665 is compact because Roller Team has worked out how to make every inch count.
At just 6.41 metres long and 2.15 metres wide, the Kronos Compact 665 gives you the practicality and comfort of a coachbuilt motorhome while retaining the manoeuvrability that makes exploring smaller roads, towns and campsites so much easier. Built on the Ford Transit 2.0-litre 165BHP automatic upgrade, with a 3500kg MTPLM, this is a motorhome that feels equally at home on a weekend escape or a longer European adventure.
Automatic driving without the effort
The 8-speed automatic gearbox is a particularly welcome addition when you're touring. Whether you're navigating city traffic, winding country lanes or settling into a long motorway journey, the automatic transmission takes the hard work out of driving.
The Roller Team Driver's Pack adds even more appeal, bringing the 165BHP engine, Moondust Silver cab, 16" alloy wheels, high-series headlamps with static bending, full-colour bumpers and side mouldings, plus the Trend interior accent pack.
The result is a smart-looking, purposeful motorhome with the performance and equipment to match.
A layout that really works
Inside, the Kronos Compact 665 is all about flexibility.
The front lounge provides a welcoming space for relaxing, dining and enjoying a morning coffee, while the electric drop-down bed gives you a proper sleeping area without permanently sacrificing your daytime living space.
Move towards the rear and you'll find the transverse bedroom positioned above a large rear garage. It's a clever use of space that gives you generous storage underneath for bikes, outdoor furniture, camping equipment, boots and all those things you inevitably want to take with you.
There's also a panoramic rooflight over the cab, helping the interior feel bright and open rather than like a conventional compact motorhome.

Presented in excellent condition throughout, this 2019 Auto-Trail Imala 625 is a highly sought-after two berth motorhome offering a spacious end lounge layout, automatic transmission and just 12,100 miles from new. Built on the reliable Fiat Ducato chassis, the Imala 625 combines comfortable touring with practical day-to-day usability, making it an ideal choice for couples looking to explore in comfort.
The exterior features Auto-Trail's distinctive modern styling with attractive grey and white coachwork complemented by sleek graphics. The overcab profile provides additional storage space while maintaining the classic motorhome silhouette. Large habitation windows allow plenty of natural light inside, while the side entrance door offers easy access to the living area. Compact enough to remain manageable on the road yet spacious once parked, the Imala 625 is perfectly suited to both touring holidays and longer adventures.
Stepping inside, you are welcomed by a bright, warm and inviting living space finished in attractive light upholstery with quality wood-effect cabinetry throughout. The practical layout maximises every inch of space, creating a comfortable and homely environment.

Large windows on three sides flood the lounge with natural light, creating an open and airy feel. In the evening, the lounge easily converts into a spacious double bed, offering comfortable sleeping accommodation for two.
The central kitchen is well equipped for touring, featuring a hob, oven and grill, sink with mixer tap, microwave, fridge and ample storage for groceries and kitchen essentials. The practical worktop space makes meal preparation straightforward whether you're away for a weekend or an extended trip.

Located at our Flintshire branch, the 2026 Swift Carrera 132 is a brand-new van conversion offering a refined blend of practicality, comfort and modern touring convenience. Built on a high-quality chassis and powered by a 2200cc diesel engine paired with an automatic gearbox, this right-hand-drive model delivers a smooth, confident and efficient driving experience suitable for both short breaks and longer adventures.
The Carrera 132 is a two-berth, two-seatbelt layout designed for couples seeking a compact yet spacious touring option. Its standout feature is the comfortable end-lounge layout, which creates a relaxed seating area during the day and easily converts into a generous sleeping space at night. Measuring 6.36 metres in length, 2.72 metres in height and 2.26 metres in width, the vehicle offers an ideal balance between interior space and road manoeuvrability. With an MTPLM of 3500kg, it can be driven on a standard driving licence while still accommodating essential touring equipment.
Inside, the Swift Carrera 132 is thoughtfully equipped to provide convenience and comfort throughout your travels. The living space benefits from swivel cab seats, loose-lay carpets and a well-appointed kitchen area that includes a hob, grill and a fridge freezer. The onboard washroom features a toilet and shower, ensuring full independence wherever you choose to stay. The vehicle is fitted with an onboard water tank and a TV aerial, adding to its self-sufficiency and entertainment options.
Driving comfort and safety are supported by ABS brakes, twin airbags, power steering, cruise control, cab air conditioning, electric windows and cab blinds. Modern technology features include a DAB radio, reversing camera and multiple USB charging points. Alloy wheels and a solar panel further enhance the overall specification, providing style as well as practical off-grid capability.
As a brand-new 2026 model, the Swift Carrera 132 comes with a full manufacturer’s warranty and is available now for viewing at our Flintshire branch.

Rear Camera
 The Chausson Welcome 620 is a highly sought-after coachbuilt motorhome renowned for its innovative use of space, flexible living areas and suitability for both couples and families. Built on a Ford Transit chassis, it offers a blend of performance and practicality.
The defining characteristic of the Welcome 620 is its full-size, electrically operated drop-down double bed. This ingenious design allows the bed to retract neatly into the ceiling when not in use, creating a vast and open living space during the day. This provides the best of both worlds: a comfortable fixed bed at night and a spacious lounge during the day. With the bed stowed away, the front lounge consists of two opposing side sofas and a central forward facing settee, capable of comfortably seating 5-6 people around a large adjustable dining table. The cab seats swivel to integrate into this lounge space, further enhancing the social area.
A major advantage of the Welcome 620s layout is its generous full-width rear washroom. This includes a cassette toilet, wash basin with mixer tap, and a dedicated spacious separate shower cubicle. There’s ample storage found in the washroom in the form of a large wardrobe.
The central kitchen is designed for functionality on the road, consisting of a 3-burner gas hob, a grill, large 3-way fridge with freezer compartment, sink with mixer tap and practical worktop space along with decent cupboard and drawer storage.
The Welcome 620 boasts a large, full-width garage at the rear, accessible from multiple exterior doors. This makes it ideal for storing larger items such as bikes, outdoor furniture and other gear, making it perfect for active adventurers.
The Chausson Welcome 620 stands out for its clever layout that maximises living space within a sub 7 metre length. Its combination of a large lounge, versatile drop down bed, spacious washroom and generous garage makes it a highly practical and comfortable choice for a wide range of motorhoming adventures.

This Tracker EKS has been professionally uprated to a 4,000kg Maximum Technically Permissible Laden Mass (MTPLM), providing a generous payload for longer trips and extended touring.

If you're looking for a campervan that gives you the freedom to explore without feeling like you're driving a small bus, the 2027 Auto-Trail Expedition 67 is a very clever answer.
At 5.99 metres long, the Expedition 67 is compact enough for narrow country lanes, coastal roads, town centres and those little campsites where larger motorhomes simply become hard work. Yet inside, the clever end-lounge layout gives you a genuinely comfortable place to relax, while the elevating pop-top transforms this two-berth campervan into a four-berth adventure machine.

The Expedition 67's rear end lounge is one of the reasons this campervan is so appealing.
During the day, it gives you a proper area to sit back and relax rather than simply a pair of seats squeezed around a table.
It's the perfect place for breakfast before heading out, somewhere to put your feet up after a day on the beach, or a cosy retreat when the weather decides that your plans need changing.
And because the lounge isn't permanently occupied by a fixed bed, the interior remains wonderfully flexible.
Then, when bedtime arrives, the pop-top opens up the possibilities above, allowing this compact campervan to sleep up to four people. Auto-Trail specifically describes the Expedition 67 as transforming from a two-berth into a four-berth when equipped with its pop-top roof.

This van is my pride and joy and i've loved every second of owning and travelling in it. After extensive research in design, components and layout the van was lovingly crafted to get every detail just right.

2020 VW Crafter CR35 2.0 TDI - Self-Built Off-Grid Campervan
 Located in Huddersfield
Selling my self-built VW Crafter campervan, converted last year with great attention to detail. My professional background is as a fitter/welder working with Hiab and Palfinger truck bodies, electrical systems and hydraulics.
Vehicle & Service History
* 2020 VW Crafter CR35 2.0 TDI
* 145,000 miles - second owner
* Service history/book up to approx. 90,000 miles
* Regular servicing and maintenance carried out by myself since 120,000 miles
* Full service, front and rear brake pads, glow plugs and cambelt replaced at 142,000 miles
* Alternator replaced at approx. 137,000 miles
* MOT until 6 July 2027
Living & Sleeping
Designed for 3 people travelling, with sleeping space for 2.
* Sliding double bed (approx. 185 x 150cm) with storage underneath
* Pull-out toilet built into shower cupboard
* Hot and cold shower
* Kitchen with sink, induction hob, 65L compressor fridge/freezer and extra workspace
* Space for a coffee machine or air fryer
* Seating area with table and swivel front passenger double seat
* Roof fan, roof window, USB sockets, reading lights and TV mounting point
Off-Grid Electrical System
* 400Ah total Renogy LiFePO4 batteries
* 370W solar panels
* Victron MPPT, 30A DC-DC charger and 20A mains charger
* Renogy 2000W inverter
* 240V mains hook-up
Water System
* 60L fresh and 60L waste water tanks
* Tank level sensors and electric waste drain
Hot Water
10L Bobil calorifier heats water from the engine coolant while driving, with additional heating options via 12V, 230V or the diesel heater.
Exterior & Comfort
* Fiamma awning
* Towbar
* Four-camera system: front, reversing and both mirror cameras
* Soundproofed and insulated with Dodo mats and thermal wool
The van drives very well, with no suspension knocks or bangs. It weighs approx. 3,100kg, leaving useful payload within its 3,500kg GVW.
We have used it for two summers and two long European trips, including a six-week Balkan adventure reaching Albania. The large water tanks, solar and 400Ah battery bank make it ideal for off-grid camping.
Private sale - no dealers, please. Viewing welcome.

A  newly converted ex MOD 2017 Citron Relay campervan with an exceptional off-grid electrical setup, sleeping up to 5 people while retaining 5 belted travel seats. Finished to a high standard throughout with fixed rear double bunk beds, shower room, hot water system, induction cooking and a massive 600Ah lithium battery bank. Perfect for families wanting the freedom to spend extended periods away from campsites without compromising on comfort.
Built for genuine off-grid camping, this camper combines a generous 91-litre fresh water tank, 50-litre waste tank, hot water system and built-in shower, allowing you to remain self-sufficient for extended periods. The substantial water capacity means fewer trips to refill, while hot running water and shower facilities provide the comfort of home wherever you travel. Coupled with the impressive Renogy electrical system featuring 600Ah of lithium battery capacity, solar charging and a 3000W inverter, it is exceptionally well equipped for extended adventures away from campsites and hook-ups.
One of the major benefits of this camper is that there is no need for gas or LPG. Cooking is provided by the 230V induction hob, powered by the substantial Renogy electrical system. This eliminates the hassle of carrying, storing and refilling gas bottles while providing a safer, cleaner and more convenient camping experience.
The camper features dedicated USB charging points throughout, allowing convenient charging of phones, tablets and other devices. The seating area includes a reading light, while each of the fixed rear bunk beds has its own 12V bedside light connected directly to the leisure battery system. It also contains 2 x 230volt outlets in the kitchen area which are currently used to run an air fryer, induction hob, and laptop charging. Power provided by the Renogy electrical system
A genuinely versatile family campervan offering comfortable sleeping for five, five belted travel seats, excellent payload capacity and one of the best off-grid electrical systems you will find in a camper of this size. Ready for immediate adventures with nothing to spend.

details.description: Motorhome Depot are pleased to bring to market this fantastic 2016 Fiat Doblo Hi Top Campervan, with only 4578 miles on the clock and only 2 previous owners is in excellent condition.  Professionally converted by its present owner (Excel VW Campervans) with over 40 yrs experience in custom building campervans this camper is a stunning example of use of space and attention to detail, both of which are second to none as every inch of space has been maximised to create a small but perfectly formed off grid camper that is also perfect for everyday use.  Once in the back of the van, you will see it is fully equipped with a 2-burner gas hob, sink with fold down tap, 34 litre water tank and a 12v compressor fridge. All housed perfectly within the bespoke hand built 15mm units in a lovely walnut finish with contrasting hammered granite worktop. The amazing selection of storage units have been carefully worked out to maximise the space available and have been fitted with LED lighting for convenience.   Opposite the kitchen is a upholstered 6ft bench seat, making a comfortable area to sit and dine with the use of the fold away table that is stored conveniently in the over cab locker. At bedtime this bench currently doubles as a comfortable single bed but upon request can be modified to sleep 2 people and underneath you will find yet more storage and space for the porta loo.  Other great features are the various LED lighting that has been installed in the roof with additional low level feature lighting, usb and 12v power points all running off the leisure battery which is constantly topped up by the 80watt solar panel with dual charging system. There is also the option of a 230v hook up running several sockets for when you are parked up on site.   In the colder months the van has been insulated and is kept warm via the propex heater which can run off the electric or gas giving you the option to be fully independent for those off grid adventures.  All in all, this small but mighty, totally bespoke one off campervan is a must have for anyone looking for a practical everyday vehicle but with the ability to head further afield for some great adventures and will come with 12 months MOT and a service.  Please do not hesitate to contact me for additional pictures, walk round video, further information or to arrange a viewing.  Viewing available at NR34

Based on the 150BHP long wheelbase T6.1 chassis, the Highline base vehicle offers heated windscreen, media unit with reversing camera, front and rear reversing sensors and fully automatic transmission. Front seats are trimmed in All Seasons signature leather stitched upholstery, while the swivel double passenger seat is on runners for easy turning. The rear Reimo seat sits on recessed track rails, allowing for multiple positions depending on the amount of rear storage required. Its super quick to convert in to a comfortable bed too. There are also two tables which lock into the floor rails, making for a very versatile dinette area. To the rear door is a fitted storage bag with two Reimo chairs, what a neat idea. Internal furniture is finished in a beautiful forest green hue with contrasting gloss kitchen splashback and Corian worktop, having a deep inset kitchen sink and stylish two burner hob. Below you will find a 50 litre fridge with slide out compartment allowing tall bottle storage. Water is supplied via an onboard fitted tank and a water heater is also present, plus an external plug in shower hose for muddy boots, dogs etc. On this long wheelbase version, there is plenty of worktop space, storage and even a wine rack. All habitation windows have pleated blinds, while the roof shroud has two mesh panels plus a front window and can be fully zipped out. Outside, you will find the VW bodywork in outstanding condition and tastefully styled, with a roll out sun canopy mounted over the habitation door and solar panel on the roof, plus easy access to water and power ports. Overall, a highly attractive and very well presented premium campervan, rare to find on LWB with automatic transmission. Located in Tyne and Wear, viewing is by appointment only, please contact Chris Gage on 07375 074407 for more information and over 80 photos.

Rove Motorhomes Gunthorpe are excited to offer this stunning AUTO-SLEEPER WARWICK XL. This is a very popular two berth, two belt panel van with a rear lounge layout. This motorhome has a maximum vehicle weight of 3500Kgs so can be driven by anyone with a full UK driving licence and comes with two sets of keys. The external length is 6.3m and it has an overall width of 2.25m.

Derby Motorhomes are delighted to present this superb 2021 Auto-Sleepers Broadway EB, a beautifully designed 2 berth luxury motorhome combining British craftsmanship, comfort and a highly desirable full-width rear washroom.
With 29,831 miles and 2 owners, this impressive motorhome features a 2.2-litre 165 bhp turbo diesel engine paired with a 6-speed manual gearbox, offering confident performance for your next touring adventure.
Step inside to discover a bright, spacious front lounge with comfortable opposing seating, ideal for relaxing, dining or entertaining. At night, the lounge converts into a generous double bed or two singles, giving couples flexible sleeping options.
The well-equipped kitchen includes a domestic-style oven and grill, 3-burner gas hob with electric hotplate, microwave and large 3-way fridge-freezer, making it easy to enjoy home-cooked meals wherever you travel.
At the rear, the impressive full-width washroom offers a separate shower cubicle, cassette toilet, vanity washbasin and integrated wardrobe access, providing excellent privacy and everyday convenience.
For year-round comfort, the Broadway EB benefits from Truma Combi gas and electric heating and hot water, LED lighting and a digital control panel. A 100W solar panel and 25-litre underslung refillable LPG tank add convenience when touring away from home.
Insulated 102-litre fresh water and 78-litre waste water tanks further support longer trips. At 6.32 metres long, this motorhome strikes an appealing balance between generous living space and manageable exterior dimensions.
With a maximum authorised weight of 3,500 kg and a stated payload of 362 kg,
Registration BF71 ZXT. With 2 berths, 2 belted travel seats and a practical lounge conversion layout, this Auto-Sleepers Broadway EB is an excellent choice for couples seeking quality, versatility and comfort.

details.description:
This stunning Itineo (Rapido) PS700 life & Elite packs*, 6 bed/6 travelling seats, Automatic Ford Transit based 2.0L engine, up-plated to 4,000kg, low mileage, air-conditioned  motorhome offers extremely versatile, tastefully styled accommodation, fully equipped & ready to go. Avail 21/10
As we are moving, we will now spend the next year renovating our next property, hence this reluctant sale
With low mileage & in excellent condition, this beautiful motorhome has been used by two but offers flexible accommodation suitable for up to six passengers wanting to explore.  It also accommodates dogs travelling safely on the lower bunk.  Carefully styled with quality new furnishings, fixtures & fittings, the motorhome is ready with everything you need to set off safely and in comfort
The Automatic gearbox, comfortable cab seating and great visibility make the vehicle an absolute pleasure to drive and there is a media system that is equipped with Apple CarPlay so you can use navigation and stay connected while on the road.  With two Lithium 1,920Wh leisure batteries & two 11kg bottles Gas-Low system feeding the two burner hobs, central heating, hot water and fridge, the system offers great Off Grid scope.  There are multiple adaptors for the Gas-Low external fitting and also for the electric hook-up for different country requirements. 10m & 25m electric hook up cables are included, as well as 2 food grade hosepipes
On the technology side there is a 5G Motorhome WiFi antenna  with a removable modem (accepts SIM or eSIM for data plans) so it can also be used when you are away from the motorhome.  There is a 32" HD smart tv that runs on either 12V or mains and is mounted on a swivel wall bracket.  The Truma Air-con/heating unit installed was an invaluable asset during the heatwaves this summer
The cab seats can be rotated to give extra space and seating to the lounge area, adding to the flexibility for a larger group.  The electric drop down bed can be lowered down or just lowered half way to give easy access if using the seats below for another large bed.  With that and the bunk beds, the layout lends itself to suit all situations.  The lower bunkbed can also be lifted to extend the garage space vertically, making plenty of room to fit bikes etc
All decorative items included as seen in video/photos
For all other included items, including security additions, please see (vehicle features) for details

2018 Auto-Trail V-Line 635 SE | 2 Berth | 32,000 Miles | Rear U-Shaped Lounge | £44,995
This stunning 2018 Auto-Trail V-Line 635 SE is a superb example of a premium 2 berth campervan, combining a highly desirable rear U-shaped lounge with excellent touring practicality and Auto-Trail's renowned build quality. With just 32,000 miles and an excellent selection of extras, this is a fantastic opportunity at £44,995.
The standout feature of the V-Line 635 SE is undoubtedly its fantastic rear U-shaped lounge, creating a wonderfully spacious and sociable living area. The generous seating arrangement is perfect for stretching out, relaxing or enjoying meals, while the surrounding windows and opening rear doors provide a bright and airy atmosphere with fantastic views of your surroundings.
At night, the rear lounge converts into a large and comfortable double bed, providing excellent sleeping accommodation without sacrificing valuable living space throughout the day. This versatile arrangement is particularly appealing to couples who appreciate having a generous lounge rather than a permanent fixed bed.

A fantastic opportunity to purchase a low-mileage 2017 Peugeot Boxer 440 L4H3 BlueHDi S/S camper van, showing just 12,250 miles. Bought with just 700 miles before conversion.
This is a spacious and practical self-build camper conversion with a fixed rear double bed, excellent storage throughout and a substantial lithium power system. The L4H3 body provides plenty of interior space, making this an ideal camper for weekends away, extended touring and longer European trips.
THE CAMPER CONVERSION
The fixed rear bed has a new mattress fitted in April this year, which has had minimal use. A convenient slide-out table is stored beneath the bed, providing a useful dining or working area.
There is an impressive amount of storage throughout the van, including:
High-level storage cupboards
Over-cab storage
Multiple low-level cupboards
Cutlery drawer
Pull-out larder cupboard
Small wardrobe beneath the bed
Generous under-seat storage
Under-bed rear storage area
The under-seat storage also provides a dedicated space for the Porta Potti toilet, together with a built-in privacy screen.
ELECTRICAL & POWER
One of the highlights is the 2300 Vehicle Power Hub, featuring a substantial 180Ah / 2300Wh Lithium-ion LiFePO4 battery.
The system includes:
40A AC charger for charging from electrical hook-up
In-vehicle charging capability
Solar charging capability if you choose to add solar panels
This provides the following:-
12V Fridge Freezer
Touch-sensitive interior lighting
12V cold-water pump
12V MaxxAir fan
230V sockets for use when connected to electrical hook-up
KITCHEN & COMFORT
The camper is equipped with a 115-litre fridge/freezer, providing plenty of capacity for longer trips.
Large deep sink with cold supplied over tap along with a long L-shaped clear worktop area.
Ventilation is provided by a MaxxAir MaxxFan Deluxe remote-controlled ceiling fan, particularly useful during warmer weather and overnight stays.
There is also a 50-litre fresh-water tank and 38-litre Wastemaster for wastewater.
DRIVING & ECONOMY
The Boxer benefits from a factory-fitted speed limiter set to 56mph, making for relaxed driving while helping achieve an average fuel consumption of approximately 40mpg.
WEIGHT / LICENCE
The vehicle has a MAM/GVW of 4,005kg, giving an approximate 850kg payload.
Please note: due to the 4,005kg GVW, a C1 licence is required to drive this CAMPER.
MOT
This expires 07.10.2027

The automatic engine makes longer journeys a breeze, while the sub-6-metre length keeps things easy when navigating narrow roads, busy car parks, campsites and ferry crossings. Solar power adds a little more freedom, while the TV point, USB ports, Bluetooth and Apple CarPlay™ / Android Link keep you connected when you want them. With reversing camera, parking aids, electric step and plenty of thoughtful touches, the Trekker XF is ready whenever you are. 🌊🌲

Built on the Ford Transit automatic, the 640 offers a superb combination of easy driving, generous living space and an incredibly versatile interior. It is particularly well suited to couples, while the clever layout also provides the flexibility to accommodate up to four people.

Above the lounge is the electric drop-down double bed, which lowers at the touch of a button when it's time for bed and disappears neatly away during the day. This is a fantastic use of space, allowing you to have a generous fixed sleeping area without sacrificing the excellent daytime living space.
Moving through the centre of the motorhome, the kitchen is both stylish and practical, with a generous 167-litre fridge/freezer, cooking facilities, sink and useful storage. Everything is positioned to make the most of the available space while retaining the feeling of openness throughout the habitation area.
One of the biggest attractions of the 640 is the full-width rear washroom. Rather than simply squeezing a bathroom into the back of the motorhome, Chausson has created a genuinely spacious area incorporating a separate shower, toilet, washbasin and substantial wardrobe space. It gives the rear of the motorhome a real feeling of luxury and privacy.
Beneath the rear washroom is the large garage, providing plenty of room for bikes, outdoor furniture and all the equipment you need for longer trips away.

details.description:
Stylish & practical, the Roller Team Zefiro 675, offers genuine space for the whole family without feeling like you’re compromising on home from home comfort.
Powered by the Ford Transit 2.0 TDCi 130bhp diesel with a six-speed manual gearbox, this Euro 6b motorhome is equally suited to family holidays, European touring or simply escaping for a few days whenever you fancy it. With 58,265 miles, just two owners from new and two keys, it has a reassuringly straightforward history.
Clean and well maintained. With six seats and six berths, with a fixed double above the cab, twin rear bunks and a further double made from the spacious front dinette. During the day, the dinette becomes a comfortable social space for eating, relaxing or planning the next day’s adventure.
The rear bunk arrangement is one of this Zefiro’s particularly clever features. The lower bunk can be lifted to create a larger rear garage, giving you somewhere to carry bikes, outdoor equipment, luggage and all the things that make a proper motorhome trip enjoyable. There’s a large wardrobe and plenty of additional storage throughout.
The kitchen is genuinely usable, with generous worktop space, a large stainless-steel sink, three-burner gas hob, Thetford Duplex oven and grill and large Dometic fridge. The separate bathroom gives you a proper shower cubicle alongside the Thetford toilet, washbasin, storage and towel rail.
Comfort hasn’t been overlooked either. The motorhome benefits from heating and hot water, two rooflights, LED lighting, integrated blinds and flyscreens, while the Roller Team control panel keeps an eye on the important onboard systems. There’s a leisure battery, mains hook-up, 120W solar panel, external fresh-water and waste connections and an external gas locker with space for two bottles. Fresh-water capacity is approximately 100 litres, with a 120-litre waste-water tank.
The Ford cab provides electric windows, remote central locking, driver and passenger armrests, cruise control and a reversing camera, making the vehicle particularly easy to live with on longer journeys
