2016 Auto-Trail Tribute 670 - 2.3 Diesel Manual
A practical and versatile 2-berth campervan, 4 belted seats that has been thoughtfully set up for travelling, family adventures and off-grid camping.
The van has had three owners from new and has been part of our family for a number of years, including being owned by my late mother. It has been well used, enjoyed and cared for, and we are now looking for a new owner to continue enjoying it.
It has also had additional work carried out to reinforce the rear shock absorbers, adding to the practical upgrades already made to the van.
**Sleeping & living space**
The rear has been modified away from a typical T670 and closer to an expedition  68 -to create a fixed bed with a large garage/storage area underneath. The garage is particularly useful for bikes, outdoor equipment, surfboards, camping gear and general storage.
Although officially a 2-berth, we also have a Cabbunk system which fits onto the front swivel cab seats and provides sleeping space for two children up to 70kg it could be considered a 4-berth.
There is also a dining table and the van has 4 travelling seats with seat belts, making it practical for travelling with a family.
**Kitchen & facilities**
* Large-capacity fridge with selectable fuel options
* Oven with grill
* Gas hob
* Truma heating and hot water system
* Shower and toilet
* Electronic control panel
* Approximately 90L fresh water capacity
* Approximately 90L waste water capacity
* LPG tank
* Habitation air conditioning
The shower hose has also been extended for outdoor use, which is particularly useful for washing down dogs, muddy equipment or rinsing surfboards after a day at the beach.
**Off-grid setup**
The van has an additional solar panel fitted to the roof, along with two new leisure batteries fitted in 2025.
This setup provides approximately 3 days of off-grid use, although this can be longer depending on how much water and electricity is used.
**Exterior & extras**
* Awning
* Double bike rack fitted to the rear doors
The original driver and passenger seat covers are included but are not shown in the photos.
Despite the cosmetic marks and normal signs of use, the main equipment and systems are working really well, and it is ready to be used and enjoyed by its next owner.
Open to sensible offers, and I'd also consider a part exchange for the right VW Caravelle.

details.description:
A spacious and genuinely versatile motorhome that combines comfort, practicality and freedom.
Designed with families, couples and adventure seekers in mind, this rare rear bunk-bed layout delivers one of the most sought-after combinations in the motorhome market, generous sleeping space, huge storage capacity and a social interior that genuinely feels like a home from home.
Powered by the reliable and economical 2.3 Multijet II Euro 6c diesel engine, this motorhome is fully ULEZ compliant, making it ideal for both countryside escapes and city touring across the UK and Europe. With only 48,650 miles and MOT until March 2027, weighs under 3.5kg can be driven on a standard licence.
Finished in classic white with a stylish walnut and beige interior, the cabin and living area feel modern, warm and welcoming. Whether you’re planning weekend escapes, summer road trips, festival adventures, family holidays or long-term touring, this layout gives you flexibility without compromise.
One of the standout features is the superb 6 berth sleeping capability with six travelling seatbelts, making it increasingly desirable for growing families or those wanting to travel with friends and grandchildren. The rear fixed bunk beds create a dedicated sleeping area that children absolutely love, while the spacious over-cab double and convertible lounge dining area provide additional comfortable sleeping arrangements.
The bright lounge and dining area creates a sociable atmosphere with large windows with integrated blinds and mesh screens allow natural light to flood the interior while maintaining privacy and comfort for a further double sleeping area.
The kitchen is well equipped for extended touring, featuring a DOMETIC SMEV triple gas hob, stainless steel sink, kitchen extension worktop and DOMETIC fridge freezer, giving you everything needed for cooking on the road without sacrificing convenience.
The full washroom includes sink, toilet, shower cubicle, shower blinds and useful storage, allowing true off-grid capability and independence wherever your travels take you.

details.description:
Don’t let the compact 6-metre footprint of the Chausson First Line C514 fool you — this motorhome is small but mighty! 🚐✨
Inside, the front lounge transforms into a comfortable space for up to five people, with swivelling cab seats and an extending table — perfect for relaxing, enjoying a meal 🍽️ or planning tomorrow’s adventure. 🗺️ Full blinds create a cosy, private retreat in the evening, while outside, the awning gives you your own little outdoor living space for fresh air and sunset drinks. 🌅☕
One of the real stars of the C514 is the oversized rear garage. 🚲 With shelving, lighting, anchor bars, heating, power sockets and even internal access from the motorhome, there’s room for all the important stuff — from walking boots and outdoor gear 🥾 to paddleboards, sun loungers and even the family dog! 🐾
The kitchen is ready for everything from a quick breakfast to a proper evening meal, with a hob, grill and fridge-freezer keeping everything you need close at hand. 🍳🥐🥂
Sleeping is wonderfully simple, with two fixed beds that are always ready to go — no evening bed-making required! 😴 The upper bed can also be used as handy extra storage when you need more room for your gear.
The washroom makes clever use of every inch, with a pivoting wall creating a separate shower area. 🚿 This helps keep the toilet and towels dry while making the whole space practical and easy to use.
Modern comforts are dotted throughout, including USB ports and power sockets, plus cab air conditioning, cruise control and a multimedia system with DAB radio, Sat Nav and hands-free connectivity. 🎶📱
Compact enough for everyday adventures, yet packed with clever features and serious storage, the C514 is ready for weekends away, longer trips and everything in between. 🌲🏖️🚐

Benimar Tessoro 486 | 2020 (70 Plate) | Ford 2.0 Diesel Manual 170bhp | 3500kg | 4 Berth | 4 Belts | LOW DROP DOWN BED
Based in Driffield, East Yorkshire.
A smart Benimar Tessoro 486 on the Ford Transit 170bhp base, 6.98m in length and 3500kg, finished in white with a modern profile and genuinely light to drive thanks to the Ford's ABS, ESP traction control and Hill Assist. First registered September 2020, this one owner example has covered just 30,000 miles and comes with full main dealer service history, 2 keys and MOT running to September 2027.
The cab is comfortable for touring, with air conditioning, cruise control, Bluetooth, DAB radio, and an integrated touchscreen with sat nav and rear view camera.Inside, the layout sleeps 4 across two separate double beds, including a space saving low drop down double over the lounge, which lowers all the way to the seat bases with no ladder required (1.39m x 1.9m), and a front lounge make up double (1.4m x 2.1m) formed from the swivelling captain's seats and dinette, giving genuine flexibility for couples or a small family.
The kitchen is fully featured with a dual fuel hob, oven, grill, fridge/freezer and microwave, and the washroom includes a separate shower and toilet. Swivel cab seats, roller blinds, and well finished woodwork throughout give a comfortable, homely feel, and Benimar's 99% wood-free construction with Grade III insulation and Truma heating means it's built for year round use.Practical features include a roof mounted solar panel, a Trackstar GPS tracker, exterior BBQ and shower points, an awning, and a Gaslow refillable gas system fitted with an 11kg refillable bottle alongside a 6kg Calor bottle for extra flexibility.
A full picture file is available upon request, along with a video.
Part exchange welcome, finance options available, and 31 days free drive away insurance can be arranged.

details.description:
Chausson Flash 718 EB ( 2016 ) 5 Berth Right Hand Drive Motorhome. Ford 2.2TDCi, 6 speed manual gearbox with cruise control and power assisted steering . Very low mileage of 14000 miles with a full, up to date, service history . Length 7.46 metres, width 2.35 metres, height 2.9 metres. GVW of 3500kg therefore no driving licence restrictions.
It will be sold with a full service, habitation service, 12 monthsMOT and 3 months warranty.
This range topping magnificent Chausson is truly stunning. With very low mileage and full service history it represents a great opportunity for anyone wanting a spacious, yet cosy motorhome. Add to this the fact it's GVW is 3500kg allowing anyone with a standard driving licence to drive it. The amazing wind up bed gives you a fantastic amount of space in the rear garage and the drop down bed over the lounge means your guests have a proper bed to sleep on. What more could you want, oh hang on it's based on the ever popular Ford Transit 2.2TDCi which is chain driven so no cam belt or wet belt to worry about.
Excellent white bodywork with graphics. Fitted with Fiamma Awning, TV aerial, Fiamma cycle rack, huge rear garage, gas locker and 240v hookup point.
The interior is in excellent conditionwith leather and fabric upholstery and light wood look vinyl flooring.
Walking in through the habitation door you are in the kitchen. In front of you is an L shaped worktop with inbuilt 3 burner hob, a sink with mixer tap and below are storage cupboards, drawer and a grill. Turn around and you have a large Dometic Fridge/Freezer. Above this is a storage cupboard and a TV on a slide out bracket.
Heading back from the kitchen you encounter a full size shower cubicle on your right and on your left a washroom with Thetford toilet, wash basin and cabinets. Between here and the kitchen is a sliding door creating a full en-suite to the rear bedroom.
Once in the bedroom you have an island bed ( 140cm wide x 190cm long ) with easy access either side and two wardrobes , over head storage and the all important shelves either side of the bed. This bed can be raised substantially to create extra space in the garage underneath.
Walking back to the front you have the lounge. There are two swivel seats, a forward facing sofa ( fitted with two x 3 point seatbelts ) a small side facing sofa and a table which can adjust to multiple locations, even dropping it down as a coffee table or even further as a base for a single extra. Electric double bed over lounge.

This stunning 2018 Benimar Mileo 282 is a superb example of a spacious and beautifully designed 4 berth motorhome, featuring the highly desirable rear L-shaped lounge and TWO electric drop-down double beds. With just 32,000 miles and an excellent touring specification, this is a fantastic opportunity to own a particularly versatile and comfortable motorhome at £46,995.
The standout feature of the Mileo 282 is undoubtedly its fantastic spacious rear L-shaped lounge, creating a wonderfully open and sociable living environment. This generous seating area is perfect for relaxing, entertaining or enjoying an evening after a day exploring, with large surrounding windows providing excellent natural light and panoramic views.
What really sets this model apart is its incredibly clever sleeping arrangement. Rather than having permanent beds occupying valuable floor space throughout the day, the Mileo 282 features TWO electrically operated drop-down double beds, providing comfortable sleeping accommodation for up to four people while allowing the living areas to remain spacious and uncluttered when the beds are raised.
This makes the Mileo 282 particularly appealing to couples who appreciate maximum daytime living space, while also offering the flexibility to accommodate family or guests without compromising on comfort.
The well-equipped kitchen provides everything required for extended touring adventures, with useful preparation space and plenty of storage. The onboard washroom facilities complete an exceptionally practical interior, ensuring you're fully self-contained wherever your travels take you.
Benimar are renowned for their innovative layouts, stylish interiors and excellent use of space, and the Mileo 282 is a fantastic example. The combination of the spacious rear lounge and twin electric beds creates a unique and highly desirable touring environment that's equally suited to weekends away or longer European holidays.
This particular example also benefits from an excellent specification, including a solar panel, reversing camera, alloy wheels and cycle rack. The solar panel provides additional charging capability for more independent adventures, while the reversing camera makes manoeuvring considerably easier. The cycle rack is ideal for taking bicycles along on your travels.
With 32,000 miles, TWO electric drop-down double beds, a fantastic rear L-shaped lounge and an excellent selection of extras, this is a particularly attractive example of the Benimar Mileo 282 at £46,995.
Included in the price of £46,995 is our comprehensive preparation package, featuring a free 3 Year RAC European warranty, 12 months road tax, 12 months MOT, full mechanical service, cambelt replacement where applicable, full habitation check, and a comprehensive handover and demonstration, ensuring your new motorhome is fully prepared and ready to enjoy.
As a family-run business with over 30 years' experience and more than 13,000 motorhomes sold, we remain completely independent of manufacturers, allowing us to offer honest advice across a huge variety of makes and models. We are proud to have the highest Trustpilot score in our sector and to be recognised as the No.1 Most Trusted Motorhome Dealer, giving you complete confidence when purchasing your next motorhome.

At the front, the motorhome features a comfortable L-shaped lounge and dinette, creating a sociable space for relaxing or dining. Forward-facing travelling seats with seatbelts are also incorporated into the lounge area, making it practical for travelling with additional passengers.
Moving through the motorhome, the fully equipped kitchen provides everything needed for touring, including a 3-burner gas hob, oven with grill, and a fridge with freezer compartment, along with useful storage and preparation space.
The bedroom area features two fixed single beds, positioned on either side of the motorhome. These provide easy access and a comfortable sleeping arrangement, with plenty of practical storage available both underneath and in the overhead lockers.
At the very rear is a spacious washroom, complete with a cassette toilet, washbasin and separate shower cubicle, offering excellent privacy and convenience while travelling.
With its comfortable fixed-bed layout, generous storage and well-equipped living space, the Adria Coral Plus 670 SLT is a great choice for couples looking for a practical motorhome for longer touring holidays and extended trips away.

Powered by the Peugeot Boxer 2.0 BlueHDi 130 BHP Euro 6 diesel engine with a 6-speed manual gearbox and having covered just 20,000 miles.
Inside, the highlight is the spacious rear lounge with seating on both sides and excellent natural light. At night, the lounge quickly converts to provide comfortable sleeping accommodation for two, with the flexibility of a large double or single-bed arrangement.
The well-equipped kitchen includes a 3-burner gas hob, combination oven and grill, sink and 95-litre fridge with removable freezer compartment.
The washroom provides a cassette toilet, shower and washbasin, while Whale dual-fuel heating and hot water make the Accordo suitable for comfortable touring throughout the year.

2016 Hobby Optima GE T70  - TWO years warranty included & has 12 months MOT.
Solo female van-lover here, downsizing because she's just too much van for what I need. Genuinely gutted to be selling her, but sometimes you've got to be honest with yourself. :(
The spec:
Hobby T70, fixed bed, diesel, proper kitchen (oven, 3X gas hob, big fridge with freezer, sink with chopping board, splash tiles). Dual heating - gas when you're off-grid, electric at hook-ups. Solar panel on roof. AC throughout (cab and body). TV, built in tracker (makes insurance cheaper), tow bar with electric connections, bike rack, space for two gas canisters. Built-in awning. Electric step for side door access. Surround lighting system with dimming controls. Skylight. Rotating captain's seats at front. Extendable table that seats up to 6 if required. Reversing camera at back and parking sensors front and back. Built-in sat nav, Bluetooth and phone control and driving cruise control.  Blackout blinds - super simple and easy to open and close.  Bed is HUGE and very comfy - can easily sleep 2 adults and a child with heaps of room spare.  Bed can also be used as 2 singles and the middle compartment can be removed and a shorter cushion used (comes with the van).  Guest bed in dining area.  There is a door that separates the main bedroom and front compartment making it easier for hosting, getting changed in private or using the bedroom area as ensuite privately.  The garage is also HUGE and can comfortably fit in heaps - perfect for a long trips away (months if you wanted). I've had bikes and boxes in there - despite the fact there is a bike rack on the back. Van has solid tyre tread.
Hobby as a brand is known for solid interior design and build quality - no rattling, no panel flex, genuinely quiet and sturdy on the road. You notice the difference straightaway.
Recently sorted:
New shock absorbers, new bushes and arms. 12-month MOT. She runs warm, cosy and she is genuinely easy to drive.
Bought her for fifty thousand 12 months ago, then on top of that added AC, tracker, tow bar with electric connections (can tow a car and cars indicators work too). I am proud of her and have looked after her throughout the year.  Proper investment in her. Only just over 38000 miles on the clock. She's in brilliant condition and honestly an absolute bargain for what you're getting.
German-built and it shows. On-grid, off-grid, doesn't matter.
Selling at competitive price for quick sale. :)

A fantastic opportunity to own this well-presented 2021 Sunlight Cliff motorhome, offering comfortable accommodation, practical features and everything you need for enjoyable touring. With just 60,204 miles and having had one owner from new, this motorhome has been well looked after and is ready for its next adventure.
The Sunlight Cliff provides two berths and four belted travelling seats, making it an ideal choice for couples or those looking for a versatile and comfortable motorhome. The rear end bedroom features a fixed double bed, providing a dedicated sleeping area without the need to convert the living space each evening.
Inside, the motorhome benefits from a well-equipped kitchen and washroom, including a gas hob, fridge/freezer, sink, mixer taps, hot and cold shower and cassette toilet with electric flush. Heating is provided by blown-air and gas heating, with a gas water heater for added convenience.
The cab is equipped with air conditioning, cruise control, electric windows and mirrors, central locking, power steering, ABS and a multi-function trip computer. Swivel cab seats help create a comfortable living area when parked, while the electric entrance step provides easy access.
Additional features include a leisure battery, battery charger, mains electric, external 240V connection, fresh and waste water tanks, large rooflight, flyscreen and blinds, wind-out awning and bike rack. Safety equipment includes smoke and CO2 detectors, flame-failure shut-off valves and an immobiliser.
With its fixed rear double bed, four travelling seats, excellent specification and one-owner history, this 2021 Sunlight Cliff is a great all-round motorhome for touring and weekends away.

Whether you're planning weekends in the countryside, trips to the coast, festivals or longer touring adventures, this VW Hillside Birchover gives you the flexibility to pack up and go whenever the mood takes you.

2019 Rimor Katamarano 9
Overall: 7.5/10 for a family motorhome
The Katamarano 9 is a 7-berth, 7-seat over cab motorhome based on the Renault Master 2.3 diesel.
 7.47 m long, 2.37 m wide and 3.06 m high, with a 3,500 kg maximum weight. The published payload is around 648 kg.
Excellent family layout: rear bunk beds, huge overcab double and convertible dinette beds.
7 belted travelling seats, which is a major advantage if you actually need to carry a large family.
Renault Master 2.3 130hp + 6-speed manual
Separate shower, 3-burner hob, oven option and roughly 97–100 L fridge.
The lower bunk can be folded to create additional storage/garage space — particularly useful for bikes, outdoor equipment etc.
At 3,500 kg, it can normally be driven on a standard UK  licence.
For a family, the Katamarano 9 makes much more sense than many nominal "6/7 berth" motorhomes. The rear bunks mean the children have their own beds, while the overcab bed gives adults a proper fixed sleeping area. The dining area can then be converted when required.

Motorhome Depot Worksop is pleased to showcase this 2017 Swift Rio 325, available to view at our retail forecourt in Worksop. Compact enough to stay under 6m while still offering a clever 3-berth, 4-belt layout, this is a particularly practical motorhome for those wanting something easy to handle without sacrificing comfort or storage. With 24,991 miles, a 3500kg chassis and a 6-speed manual gearbox, it combines everyday usability with plenty of touring equipment.One of the standout features is the electrically adjustable transverse rear bed, which can be raised and lowered to make the most of the garage underneath. This gives you generous storage space when needed while allowing the bed position to be adjusted to suit your requirements. Up front, the centre dinette converts into a small single bed, making the layout ideal for couples who occasionally need an extra sleeping space for a child. There’s also plenty of additional storage throughout and a TV bracket in the rear bed area.The kitchen is well equipped with a 3-burner gas hob, 1 induction hob, Thetford Aspire 2 oven/grill, Dometic fridge/freezer and microwave, giving you everything needed for comfortable meals away from home. Truma iNet heating and hot water provide year-round comfort, while the full washroom, blinds and fly screens add further practicality.Outside, the Rio benefits from a Thule bike rack, reversing camera and solar panel, making it well suited to touring adventures. The cab features air conditioning, cruise control, USB connectivity and swivel cab seats, alongside a Bluetooth radio and aerial. For added peace of mind, it also comes equipped with a Ghost immobiliser.With its under-6m footprint, clever electrically adjustable bed and garage arrangement, 3-berth flexibility, strong specification and excellent storage, the Swift Rio 325 is a great option for anyone looking for a compact motorhome that makes very clever use of its available space.Did you know you can visit our Motorhome Depot Worksop retail forecourt and browse motorhomes in person? Call our team today on 01909 286861 for further information or to arrange a viewing. All motorhomes come with FREE 31-day drive-away insurance, a new habitation check, and a comprehensive handover to give you complete peace of mind on the road.We welcome part exchanges and offer flexible finance options through our trusted partners (subject to status). 12 Month warranty included with options to upgrade at additional costs. All motorhomes come with a new habitation check and a comprehensive handover.We can also arrange upgrades including solar panels, refillable gas systems, lithium batteries, bike racks, tow bars, WiFi systems, reversing cameras, and wind-out awnings.Collection from the local railway station available — just let us know!Opening hours: Monday to Friday 9am–5pm, Saturday 10am–4pm, Sunday by appointment.
Please note, this vehicle is not a brokerage unit and as such means that it is compliant with the Consumer Rights Act 2015.

Discover the freedom to travel together in this 2018 Sunlight A72, a spacious six-berth coachbuilt motorhome designed for family adventures, longer touring holidays and spontaneous weekends away. With six travelling seats and six berths, it offers the flexibility to bring everyone along while giving you the comfort and independence to enjoy your time away at your own pace. Finished with a practical end-bedroom and fixed bunk bed layout, this is a motorhome that makes getting away together simple, comfortable and enjoyable.
Powered by a 2.3-litre 130bhp diesel engine with a six-speed manual gearbox, this right-hand-drive Sunlight has covered 52,284 miles and is well suited to everything from relaxed coastal touring to exploring the countryside. Cruise control, power steering, ABS brakes, central locking and electric windows make travelling straightforward, while the swivel cab seats help create a welcoming living environment once you arrive at your destination. The generous 7.23-metre length provides plenty of space without losing the sense of freedom that makes motorhome touring so appealing.
Inside, the six-berth accommodation provides an excellent balance of comfort and practicality, with fixed bunk beds offering an ideal sleeping area for children or additional guests and the end-bedroom creating a dedicated space to relax at the end of the day. The kitchen is equipped with a full oven and large fridge freezer, giving you the freedom to prepare everything from a quick breakfast before heading out to relaxed evening meals without having to rely on restaurants. Truma blown-air heating and gas and electric heating help keep the interior comfortable throughout the seasons, while loose lay carpets, flyscreens and a TV aerial add further convenience.
The separate toilet and shower facilities mean you can enjoy the freedom of travelling without relying on campsite amenities, while the cassette toilet, external mains socket and solar panel add practicality when spending time away from home. A fitted awning provides an easy way to extend your living space outdoors...

This Elddis Signature 115 used motorhome is built on a Peugeot chassis, with a 140bhp engine and 6-speed manual transmission, providing 2 berths and 2 travel seats. The motorhome layout comprises of an end kitchen equipped with a full oven, grill, hob and microwave, a roomy washroom ensuring that you will never need to rely on campsite shower blocks. The double bench seat lounge offers plenty of space and will convert quickly and easily into a double bed. This motorhome features an awning, solar panel, cab air conditioning and rear view camera.  Marquis Leisure are the UK's largest motorhome and caravan dealer network offering sales and servicing across 12 branches nationwide. We offer a 3 year guarantee as standard on all used motorhomes and caravans as well as NCC/AWS approved sales and servicing.

details.description: Here we have for sale a very nice Elddis Autoquest 120 2 berth coachbuilt motorhome, being the desirable slimline roof model. At approximately 7 metres long, this is a compact and very practical motorhome that offers surprisingly spacious and comfortable accommodation while remaining easy to drive, manoeuvre and park. It is an ideal choice for couples looking for a motorhome that gives you plenty of living space.The motorhome has covered just 17,180 miles, backed up by the official DVLA MOT history, and is currently MOT'd until August 2027 with a good MOT history. It comes with the full V5 logbook, with plenty of power from the 2.2 HDI diesel engine, coupled to a 5-speed manual gearbox. The chain-driven engine means there are no cambelt replacement concerns.Inside, the accommodation is clean and well presented, with the upholstery in very good condition. The front cab seats have armrests and headrests, with the both seats swivelling around into the living area. The slimline roof design provides useful storage above the cab, while the front privacy curtains provide additional comfort and privacy when staying overnight.The rear living accommodation is particularly spacious for a 2 berth motorhome. There is a good-sized bathroom incorporating a shower, Thetford flushing cassette toilet and vanity unit, together with a useful wardrobe and folding table which can be stored neatly away when not required.The main living area features a U-shaped rear lounge, with the two comfortable bench seats converting into a good-sized double bed. There is useful storage underneath the seating and a table which is ideal for enjoying meals, drinks, coffee or simply relaxing.The kitchen area is well equipped with an Elddis 3-burner gas hob, oven and grill, together with a sink providing hot and cold water and a refrigerator with freezer box. There are plenty of cupboards and storage areas throughout the motorhome, making excellent use of the available space.Heating is provided by a Whale heating system, with blinds fitted throughout. The motorhome also has 110/230V lighting and plug sockets, together with a TV aerial. The combination of the large and smaller skylights allows plenty of natural light into the living area, creating a bright, airy and spacious feel.The motorhome is compact and offers excellent visibility from the driver's position. The Autoquest 120 is very easy to drive, manoeuvre and park, even in smaller or tighter spaces. At 3500kg, it can be driven on a normal car licence, subject to the driver's individual licence entitlement.This is a great opportunity to purchase a genuinely spacious 2 berth motorhome that offers everything needed for comfortable weekends away, touring holidays and longer trips, without having to deal with the size and bulk of a larger coachbuilt, this motorhome can be viewed in Mansfield, part exchange and finance is available.

details.description:
The Auto-Trail Imala 730 is a spacious four-berth motorhome designed for those who want the freedom to get away whenever the mood takes them. With 24,358 miles, a 130bhp diesel engine and six-speed manual gearbox, it offers a comfortable and practical way to enjoy everything from relaxed weekends in the countryside to longer touring adventures.
Inside, the fixed island bed creates a welcoming rear bedroom with the feel of a true home from home, while the spacious living area provides plenty of room to relax, dine and unwind after a day exploring. The well-equipped kitchen features a dual-fuel hob, fridge freezer and microwave, giving you everything you need to enjoy meals on the road.
The separate washroom with shower adds convenience and privacy, while Truma Combi heating and gas and electric heating ensure you remain comfortable throughout the seasons. The cab is equipped with air conditioning, cruise control, Bluetooth and a reversing camera, making longer journeys more enjoyable.
When you arrive, the awning and external BBQ point make it easy to take the living space outdoors, while the solar panel and onboard water tank offer added flexibility when touring away from traditional facilities. A towbar also provides extra versatility for your adventures.
More than just a motorhome, the Imala 730 is a lifestyle choice for those who want to travel further, explore more and enjoy the freedom to make every trip their own.

Where comfort meets the open road!
The Auto‑Trail Imala 734 is the kind of motorhome that makes you grin the moment you step inside. Built on the trusted Fiat Ducato 130 MultiJet, it brings proper touring confidence with cab air‑con, cruise control and those all‑important swivel seats to open up the living space. Up front you’ve got a bright, welcoming dinette behind the cab that easily converts into a single bed, perfect for flexible sleeping arrangements across its 5 berths and 4 belted seats. Move through the van and the kitchen sits ready for real cooking — fridge, hob, grill, oven and microwave — everything placed neatly so it feels natural to use whether you’re parked up for a weekend or away for weeks. Opposite, the washroom gives you a proper separate shower, keeping things practical and comfortable. At the rear, the twin fixed single beds create a calm, easy space to unwind, with storage tucked everywhere you’d expect and a few places you wouldn’t, making long trips feel effortless.
Why buy Auto‑Trail? Because their heritage runs deep. Auto‑Trail’s legacy is built on decades of British craftsmanship, touring know‑how and a commitment to making motorhomes that feel like a proper home on wheels. The Imala range carries that tradition proudly — dependable, beautifully thought‑out and designed for people who want to get out there and live the touring life without compromise.
Call us now to get the wheels turning!

Motorhome Marketplace are pleased to present this 2016 Elddis Envy 155, based on the Peugeot Boxer and powered by a 2.2D chain driven engine producing 130BHP and running through a 6-spd man gearbox with just 19,005 miles from new.
This well appointed 4-berth motorhome is currently configured with 2 belted swivelling captains chairs and 2 bench sofas in the forward lounge which convert into a double bed. However, with the benches folded away a pair of passenger seats  fold up from the floor to create 2 further belted seats when required. At the rear is a fixed French double bed with storage below and housing for the Whale hot water/heating combi boiler, there is a TV and wall mounting in this area and additional overhead storage lockers.
The washroom is positioned at the rear next to the fixed bed and provides a shower with screen, electric flushing Thetford toilet with fold away basin above, and vanity cabinet with double mirrors over. There is also a dressing area with tall mirror and a sliding door to create privacy from the living space.
The kitchen is well equipped with ceramic hob with 3-gas burners and an electric hotplate, ceramic sink with mixer tap, grill with separate oven, microwave and a fridge freezer. There is good worktop space with an additional pop-up shelf for food prep etc. with overhead lockers above and a stack of drawers below, providing plenty of storage for food, crockery and cutlery alike.
Externally this van is equipped with a full length Dometic wind-out awning, a gas bottle locker with 2 bottles, leisure battery storage locker and outside access to the underbed storage area. At the rear of the van is a bike rack, rear view camera and toilet cassette access.
This Elddis has  an MOT until 25/04/2027, was last serviced 16/02/2026 and the habitation check was completed on 29/06/2026. For additional peace of mind it also comes with 12-months Autogard warranty.
Please call Dean on 07736 744339 for more details and additional pictures of this motorhome which is situated near Blandford Forum, Dorset. Viewings are by appointment only.

Additional features include an external awning, external gas and shower points, two leisure batteries and stylish alloy wheels.

Combining a fixed rear bed, excellent storage and a generous specification, this Auto-Trail Frontier Mohawk is a highly capable motorhome ready for comfortable touring adventures.

details.description: Motorhome Depot are pleased to present this excellent 2019 Swift Escape Compact C402 2-berth,4-belt compact motorhome. Based on the Fiat Ducato, it is powered by the 130BHP 2.3 diesel engine and 6-speed manual gearbox.Having only covered 19000 miles with 3 owners, it comes with service history, a June 2027 MOT and a fresh habcheck so the next owner can have complete peace of mind. It has a GVW of 3300kg with a payload of 600kg so it can be driven on a standard UK licence and is 5.99m long making it very easy to handle on those tricky campsites.One important thing to note regarding this motorhome is it has a full E&P Self-levelling system with remote control which is a £6k extra and is a fantastic addition to any motorhome allowing the motorhome to be raised on hydraulic stays so it can be rock-solid and level on any terrain.Entering the van from the hab door on the passenger side, we turn right to go to the superb end lounge which is a cosy space for two or four, with triple aspect glazing and a small rooflight above. There are good-sized top lockers here, too, and good bedding storage that’s easy to reach under the nearside sofa. Recessed lighting is fitted under the upper cupboards. This also converts to the sleeping area and this process is extremely easy to convert the parallel rear benches into a 1.92m by 1.28m double bed. The seat bases just pull together – no flimsy caravan-style bed slats here! And trim panels at the side walls mean that your pillows don’t touch the walls.The galley is in the centre of the ’van, along the nearside, and here you immediately notice an advantage over a (narrower) van conversion with a similar layout. The aisle between the washroom and kitchen is not as restricted. Spec includes a Triplex cooker with oven/grill, plus a sink with removable drainer and a high-level microwave. There’s plenty of worktop, even before you use the folding flap by the door and this is completed by the 85l fridge.The washroom in the C402 is also surprisingly large for a compact motorhome and you’ll find plenty of room to get washed in here, and the area is fully lined, too. There’s storage space, in the form of a small cupboard, as well as a towel ring and toothbrush holder.Remarkably for a compact motorhome, there is enough room for a dinette up front, with a pair of belted seats – so you can travel with four people on board, making this an ideal ‘van for running children around in before they pitch up a pup tent and sleep outside. Alternatively, you can use the dinette as somewhere to eat and leave the bed up permanently – ideal if you’re planning to arrive on site late at night and don’t want the hassle of making up a bed.This area also has a TV with satellite system.The Cab is well-appointed with AC,Cruise,Bluetooth and USB points.Early viewing is highly recommended because these Swift compact motorhomes are extremely popular particularly in this condition and mileage, and with the Self-levelling system, we consider this to be as good as an example as you will find at this price point. For any more information or to view the extended picture file and walkround Video or to arrange a viewing please contact Matthew on the details provided.The Motorhome is located in near Newport in Gwent. Finance,Warranty and P/ex are available and Motorhome Depot can offer 30 day insurance on purchase.

Built on a reliable Fiat Ducato chassis and powered by a 2.3L 130 BHP engine paired with a 6-speed manual gearbox, it offers a smooth and confident drive whether you are heading away for a weekend break or a longer touring adventure.
At the front, the L-shaped lounge creates a welcoming living and dining space, complemented by a side bench for extra comfort. This area is perfect for relaxing during the day, enjoying meals, or planning your next destination. The cab seats help open up the space further, creating a sociable layout that feels bright and inviting. At night this area can be turned into a comfy double bed.

Opposite the kitchen is the washroom, fitted with a cassette toilet, washbasin, and a clever design that allows the space to be transformed into a shower cubicle when needed. This makes excellent use of the available room while still providing all the essential facilities for comfortable touring.
At the rear of the motorhome is the desirable fixed island bed, offering a comfortable and easy-to-access sleeping area without the need to make up a bed each evening. Wardrobes on either side provide useful storage for clothing and travel essentials, helping to keep the living space tidy and organised.
Additional features on this Swift Escape 694 include a reversing camera, awning, solar panel, and bike rack, making it well equipped for touring, outdoor living, and off-grid adventures.
Spacious, well laid out, and fitted with the ever-popular rear island bed, this 2017 Swift Escape 694 is a fantastic motorhome for those looking to travel in comfort and style.

Chausson Flash 610 Motorhome – 4 Berth, 4 Seatbelts
Well-presented Chausson Flash 610 motorhome offering comfortable accommodation for up to 4 people, making it ideal for couples or family adventures. This versatile motorhome benefits from 4 travelling seatbelts and a practical, spacious layout designed for touring in comfort.
The accommodation includes a large overcab double bed and a generous rear lounge that converts into an additional double bed. The well-equipped kitchen features a hob, oven/grill, sink, fridge with freezer compartment and ample storage space for extended trips.
The washroom includes a cassette toilet, hand basin and shower facilities, providing all the conveniences of home while travelling. The bright and airy living area offers comfortable seating, plenty of natural light and excellent storage throughout.
Additional features include:
• 4 berth
• 4 travelling seatbelts
• Overcab double bed
• Rear lounge conversion
• Fully equipped kitchen
• Fridge/freezer
• Oven and grill
• Heating and hot water system
• Washroom with toilet and shower
• Large storage compartments
• Electric hook-up
• Bike rack (if fitted)
• Awning (if fitted)
A fantastic family motorhome that is easy to drive, practical to use and ready for new adventures. Viewing highly recommended.

Motorhome Depot are pleased to present this excellent 2019(69) Swift Escape 674 6-berth,5-belt motorhome. Based on the Fiat Ducato with the AL-KO chassis, it is powered by the reliable 2.3 Multijet engine and 6-speed gearbox. Having only covered 13800 miles with 3 owners, this motorhome will come with a recent habcheck, service history with a cambelt change and an MOT until February 2027 so the next owner can have complete peace of mind.The GVW is 3500kg with a payload of 400kg so it can be driven on a standard UK licence and is only 7.41m long so is very easy to handle.It is worth noting that the present owner has added some very useful extras costing around £5k with Truma Habitation Aircon and a very good Victron bluetooth battery system with a 1200W inverter, 3 solar panels and a Fogstar Lithium habitation battery which really enhances the off-grid capability.With both front and rear lounge options the Escape 674 offers the best of both worlds with plenty of space for relaxing and socialising in either area, all upholstery is in good condition throughout and with under seat storage. There is a large skylight over the rear lounge, with modern overhead locker design.The nearside kitchen includes 3 gas hob burners, a combination Thetford oven and grill and a microwave oven providing options for cooking and food preparation. There is also a modern Dometic tower fridge with integral ice box freezer, a circular sink with mixer tap, extendable worktop and good storage throughout.When it is time for sleep there are three double bed options from which to choose, retire straight away to the manual drop-down double bed with Duvalay mattress over the front lounge area, or make up the beds in the front or rear lounge. All the beds are well proportioned and both lounges are simple to convert into beds. At the front, quickly rearrange the seat cushions to make a double bed and the generous rear double bed can also be quickly converted from the rear lounge sofas or used as singles.The washroom has a vanity washbasin, Thetford swivel cassette toilet, mirror, locker space, skylight and integral shower. Truma controls water and space heating and the system is iNet Ready and works on both Electric and Gas.The cab includes driver and passenger airbags, skylight, Remis concertina blinds, two swivelling captain cab seats, cruise control, electric windows and mirror adjustment, multi-function leather steering wheel, leather shift lever, DAB radio, Bluetooth phone connectivity, cab air conditioning and colour reversing monitor. The motorhome has a tracker which will require subscription. On the outside there are rails for adding a bike rack and a Thule wind out awning, reversing sensors and camera.Early viewing is highly recommended because the Swift Escape 674 is very popular because of the 6-berth layout whilst being under 3500kg and with the low miles, Habitation AC and massively enhanced off-grid capability ,we consider this to be as good as an example you will find at this price point. For any more information or to view the extended picture file or walkround video or to arrange a viewing please contact Matthew on the details provided.The Motorhome is located near Cardiff in South Wales. Warranty,P/EX and finance is available along with complimentary free 30-day insurance.

Motorhome Marketplace are pleased to present this Compass Avantgarde 115, which has just been significantly reduced! It is based on a Peugeot Boxer L1 chassis so is compact and easy to manoeuvre at just 5.7m in length, yet with a light and spacious interior giving plenty of room for 2. In addition to smoke and CO detectors, an LPG Gas detector is also installed and a fire extinguisher.
Externally you have everything you need including a Fiamma 45S wind-out awning over the hab door, gas BBQ port, lockers for gas bottles, leisure battery, and toilet cassette. There is also a Fiamma 2-bike-rack and rear view camera.

2018 Knaus Sky Ti 700 MG – 3-Berth Low-Profile Coachbuilt Motorhome with Fixed Rear Transverse Bed & Separate Shower  Motorhome Depot Fylde  We are pleased to offer for sale this 2018 Knaus Sky Ti 700 MG, a spacious 3-berth low-profile coachbuilt motorhome built on the Fiat Ducato chassis. Powered by a 2.3-litre 150 bhp diesel engine with a 6-speed manual gearbox, this 7.52 metre motorhome has covered approximately 20,004 miles and provides accommodation for three with four travel seats.  The layout features a front L-shaped lounge with side seat, central living and kitchen area, toilet with a separate shower cubicle and a fixed rear transverse double bed above a large garage. The vehicle has had two owners from new and comes with an MOT until May 2027.  Living Area The front lounge offers an L-shaped seating arrangement with a side seat, and the cab seats swivel to become part of the living space. The height and reach adjustable dining table provides flexible positioning for relaxing or dining.  The dinette converts to create the third berth when required. Generous storage is available throughout, including wall cupboards over the dinette, a cubby in the floor and storage under the seating. Natural light floods the interior via a large overcab roof window, a large skylight over the dinette, and additional square skylights in the rear.  Truma Combi 6E heating provides efficient heating and hot water throughout the habitation area.  Kitchen The kitchen is equipped with a Dometic three-burner hob with glass lid and LED lighting above, a Thetford duplex oven and grill, sink with a wooden lid that doubles as the chopping board, sliding storage racks and more useful storage offering excellent facilities for preparing meals while touring.  A Dometic three-way RML 9435 fridge/freezer is also fitted, opposite the main kitchen area, with storage above and below.   Sleeping Area The rear sleeping area features a fixed transverse double bed, providing a permanent sleeping arrangement without the need to make up the bed each evening.  Two generous wardrobes are positioned each side of the bed, with wall cupboards above and a cubby in the floor. The additional square skylight is located over the bed area. The front dinette converts into a further single bed when required, giving the motorhome its three-berth capacity.  Washroom The washroom is Knaus’ ‘open bathroom’ design where the bathroom door functions as both a divider to create a large open washroom and also the door to the toiler room for privacy. The toilet room incorporates a Dometic cassette toilet, a washbasin integrated into the worktop, a tap integrated into the wall and plenty of storage. Whilst opposite is the large separate shower cubicle.   Mirrors and a square roof vent are fitted, providing good light and ventilation.  External The Knaus Sky Ti 700 MG benefits from a large rear garage beneath the fixed bed, offering excellent storage for touring equipment and personal belongings.  A wind-out Fiamma F45S awning is fitted, providing additional covered space alongside the motorhome when pitched. The gas locker accommodates two Gaslow refillable bottles, and a 100 W solar panel is installed to assist with battery charging. A single leisure battery is accessible from an external locker. Fresh and waste water tanks are fitted, along with mains hook-up.  Driving & Equipment The Fiat Ducato base vehicle is powered by a 2.3-litre 150 bhp diesel engine and is fitted with a 6-speed manual gearbox.  Driving equipment includes:    Cab      air conditioning  Cruise      control  Electric      windows and mirrors  DAB      radio with Bluetooth  Reversing      cameras and trailer vision 360 all-round camera system  Alarm      and immobiliser  Moving      Intelligence ITrack S5  Twin      view camera centre mirror screen   The vehicle has an MOT until 23 May 2027.  Habitation Features    Truma      Combi 6E heating  Dometic      three-way fridge/freezer (RML 9435)  Dometic

details.description:
The 2018 Rollerteam T-Line 740 is a 4-berth motorhome that suits families and groups who want space without stepping up to something bigger. At 2.31m wide and 7.43m in external length, it’s an easy size to drive and park, while still giving you four travelling seats for the road.
Layout and Living Space
Four travelling seats mean the whole family can travel legally and comfortably, and the drop down bed adds flexible sleeping space without eating into your daytime living area. Loose fit carpets and blinds are fitted throughout, with door flyscreens and fly screens keeping bugs out on warm evenings with the windows open.
Kitchen Facilities
You’ve got a full oven, microwave, fridge and freezer on board, so you can prepare home cooked meals on site rather than relying on the site restaurant every night. An onboard water tank means you’re not tied to a hook-up for your water supply either.
Heating and Climate
This T-Line 740 runs on blown air heating, which warms the whole van evenly with no cold corners. A Heki rooflight and sun roof bring in natural light and ventilation, with an additional large rooflight for even more.
Practical Extras
A battery charger, mains electric hook-up and stereo system are all fitted, along with alloy wheels and a spare wheel for peace of mind on the road. An alarm is fitted as standard too, and the van comes with a 2 year warranty.
Why Buy from Raymond James Caravans?
Raymond James Caravans has been in the caravan and motorhome industry for over 50 years.
Part exchange is welcome, and finance is available, subject to status. Come and see the 2018 Rollerteam T-Line 740 in person at Carlyon Road, Atherstone. We’d love to help you find the right van.

Burstner Lyseo TD 590 Harmony 2018 – Compact German-Built Touring With a Garage
This two-berth Burstner Lyseo TD 590 Harmony is a well-proportioned coach-built motorhome from 2018, ideal for couples who want easy, low-line touring without giving up practical storage. Built in Germany on a Fiat chassis with automatic transmission, it pairs straightforward driving with a genuinely useful specification for weekends away or longer trips.
End Washroom
A separate washroom sits at the rear of the motorhome, keeping the shower and toilet away from the main living area for everyday practicality on tour.
Electric Drop-Down Double Bed
An electric drop-down double bed lowers from above the lounge, giving flexible sleeping arrangements for guests without permanently taking up daytime living space.
Dinette Lounge With Swivel Cab Seats
The dinette seating works alongside swivel cab seats to create a sociable lounge area for relaxing, dining or simply watching the world go by.
Well-Equipped Kitchen
A fridge, freezer and hob are fitted as standard, giving enough capacity and cooking flexibility to prepare proper meals while away from home.
Practical Garage Storage
A garage provides external access for storing bulkier touring kit such as chairs, awning poles or outdoor equipment.
All-Round Touring Comfort
Truma blown air heating, double glazing and cab air conditioning keep the cabin comfortable in all seasons, while cruise control makes longer drives more relaxed.
Ready-to-Use Extras
A solar panel, awning, TV aerial and stereo system round out the specification, with durable GRP side panels helping keep bodywork looking good with minimal upkeep.
With part service history and just two registered keepers from new, this Lyseo TD 590 Harmony has been well cared for rather than left standing. It's a sound choice for couples after a compact, well-specified motorhome that's comfortable to drive and easy to live with once you arrive.

Known for its contemporary styling, clever layouts and excellent use of space, Sunlight motorhomes are designed to make touring enjoyable without unnecessary complexity. The Sunlight T58 Active (2020) is a particularly appealing compact coachbuilt, offering excellent accommodation within a manageable footprint. Measuring approximately 5.96m in length, 2.32m in width and 2.93m in height, with a maximum permissible mass of 3,500kg, the T58 Active provides the benefits of a full motorhome while remaining straightforward to drive and suitable for a standard UK licence, subject to licence conditions.
Starting at the rear of the motorhome, the T58 Active features a comfortable rear bedroom, providing a relaxing and private area for a good night's sleep. The fixed French bed arrangement offers excellent comfort, while the surrounding overhead lockers and storage areas provide plenty of room for clothing, bedding and personal belongings. The clever use of space makes this rear section feel considerably larger than the vehicle's compact external dimensions might suggest.
To the side, you will find the end washroom, which has been thoughtfully designed to provide all the facilities required for comfortable touring. The washroom incorporates a cassette toilet, washbasin and shower facilities, together with useful storage, giving you the convenience of having your own private bathroom wherever your travels take you.
Opposite, the well-equipped kitchen makes excellent use of the available space. With a gas hob, sink, oven / grill, refrigerator and practical worktop and cupboard storage, it provides everything required for preparing meals and refreshments on the road. Its compact but functional design ensures that the kitchen remains easy to use without dominating the living space.

The Hobby T70 E is a refined low-profile motorhome that combines German build quality with spacious, practical touring comfort. Built on a dependable Fiat Ducato chassis, this sleek coachbuilt model delivers smooth driving performance alongside a well-designed, modern living space.
At approximately 7.4 metres in length, the T70 E offers a generous interior layout centred around twin rear single beds, providing both comfort and flexibility for couples or occasional guests. With four belted travel seats, it’s equally suited to touring with friends or family.
Inside, the T70 E presents a bright and contemporary living environment. The front lounge benefits from swivelling cab seats, creating a welcoming dining and relaxation area, while the high-quality cabinetry and clever storage solutions enhance the overall “home-from-home” feel.
The fully equipped kitchen features a three-burner hob, oven/grill, and large fridge/freezer, making meal preparation effortless on the road. To the rear, a standout feature is the spacious end washroom, complete with a separate shower cubicle, toilet, and vanity unit for maximum convenience and privacy.
Designed for extended touring, the T70 E includes ample onboard water capacity, efficient heating, and excellent insulation, ensuring comfort in a wide range of climates.
Additional highlights include:
140BHP 2.2L diesel engine for reliable performance
Twin fixed single beds with optional additional sleeping space
Large rear garage and extensive internal storage
Modern infotainment system with reversing camera and navigation
Electric step, flyscreens, and integrated blinds throughout
With its combination of space, comfort, and premium European design, the Hobby T70 E is an excellent choice for those seeking relaxed, high-quality touring with all the comforts of home.

It is a 3 berth, 4 belted motorhome with the low rear single bed layout or king Size Bed. All the windows have blinds, screens and there is a lounge tv which is hooked up to the wireless satellite system this motorhome comes with. This area also converts into a single bed. In the centre of the motorhome is the kitchen consisting of a three-burner gas hob, sink, oven/grill combo and on the opposite side a large slimline three energy source Fridge/Freezer. There is plenty of storage and a pull out surface for food prep etc. LED lighting all around.
Moving to the back of the motorhome you have the split bathroom area and the bedroom which can be sealed off from the lounge/kitchen using the washroom door. There is a separate toilet and washroom on one side of the vehicle and a separate shower room on the opposite side, a great feature. There is again lots of window space giving it a great airy and light feeling. The beds are 2 singles which can also be made into an extra large double if needed. Rear TV fitted when you lay there on the bed which has ratcheted tip-up mattress supports on each side making for luxurious lounging.

The Swift Escape 694 is a spacious and versatile family motorhome that combines modern styling, practical design and exceptional comfort. Having covered just 18,633 miles, this beautifully presented motorhome is ready for its next adventure.
Built on the Fiat Ducato chassis, the Escape range is renowned for its comfortable driving experience and well thought out layouts, making it an excellent choice for couples and families alike.
Entering the motorhome, you're welcomed into a bright and spacious front lounge that makes full use of the swivel captain's seats. The twin bench seats create a sociable living area that is perfect for relaxing, dining or entertaining, while also incorporating two comfortable forward facing travel seats. A large panoramic rooflight floods the lounge with natural light, creating a wonderfully open and airy feel.
Moving into the centre of the motorhome, you'll find the well equipped kitchen. It includes a full oven with grill, three burner gas hob, fridge with freezer compartment, stainless steel sink and generous worktop space, making meal preparation simple whether you're away for a weekend or an extended tour. Clever storage throughout ensures there is plenty of room for all your kitchen essentials.
Opposite the kitchen is the washroom, complete with a toilet, wash basin and separate shower. The layout can be closed off from both the bedroom and living area, creating a private ensuite style washroom that adds another level of comfort when travelling.
At the rear of the motorhome is one of the Escape 694's standout features, the spacious island bed. Offering easy access from both sides, it provides a luxurious sleeping area with wardrobes either side and generous storage beneath the bed for larger items. This layout makes touring effortless, with no need to make up beds at the end of each day.
The Swift Escape 694 is the perfect motorhome for those looking for generous living space, a practical layout and the comfort of a fixed island bed, all wrapped up in a stylish and easy to drive package.
For more information or to request a personalised video walkthrough from our award winning team, please get in touch with us here at Tamar Caravans & Motorhomes. The Home of Adventure.

The fully equipped kitchen features a three-burner hob, oven/grill, and large fridge/freezer, making meal preparation effortless on the road. To the rear, a standout feature is the spacious end washroom, complete with a separate shower cubicle, toilet, and vanity unit for maximum convenience and privacy.
Designed for extended touring, the T70 E includes ample onboard water capacity, efficient heating, and excellent insulation, ensuring comfort in a wide range of climates.
Additional highlights include:
140BHP 2.2L diesel engine for reliable performance
Twin fixed single beds with optional additional sleeping space
Large rear garage and extensive internal storage
Modern infotainment system with reversing camera and navigation
Electric step, flyscreens, and integrated blinds throughout
With its combination of space, comfort, and premium European design, the Hobby T70 E is an excellent choice for those seeking relaxed, high-quality touring with all the comforts of home.

The front living area consists of a lounge with a L-shaped sofa and swiveling captain's chairs, creating a comfortable space for dining and relaxation. Kitchen and Bathroom: The kitchen is well-equipped with a three-burner gas hob, a large fridge-freezer, and plenty of storage. The design emphasizes both style and practicality, with high-end finishes and fixtures. The bathroom is split into a separate shower and toilet area, offering privacy and convenience. It includes a high-quality shower enclosure, a ceramic toilet, and a stylish washbasin. Additional Features: It includes a wide range of features such as LED lighting throughout, a flat-screen TV, and ample electrical outlets. The motorhome also comes with a large panoramic roof window, which enhances the feeling of space and allows for plenty of natural light.

details.description:
The Roller Team Zefiro 696 is a particularly well thought-out four-berth motorhome, with a layout designed to give you genuine comfort both on the road and when you're pitched up. Built on the Ford Transit 2.0 TDI Euro 6D, this 7.45m low-profile combines a manageable 3,500kg chassis with an interior that makes excellent use of its length.
The real attraction of the 696 is its rear island-bed layout. Rather than having to climb over or fold away the bed every night, you have a proper fixed double bed with access from both sides, creating a dedicated bedroom at the rear. Just forward of this is the separate shower and washroom arrangement, giving the motorhome a much more practical feel when travelling as a couple or family. The shower has its own dedicated space, while the toilet and vanity area are separate — a particularly useful feature when more than one person is getting ready in the morning.
At the front, the spacious lounge and dinette area makes a comfortable daytime living space, with the cab seats swivelling into the living area. When it's time for bed, the electric drop-down double bed lowers above the lounge, providing the second double without having to permanently sacrifice your seating area. Add in the well-equipped kitchen, generous storage and four belted travel seats, and the Zefiro 696 offers a very usable combination of fixed-bed comfort and flexible four-berth accommodation. This is a layout that works equally well for couples wanting extra space and families looking for a genuine four-berth motorhome.

details.description: Motorhome Depot N.I. have great pleasure in offering this unique Weinsberg X-Cursion 500 LT Pepper Edition motorhome.The unique design of the X-Cursion model brings fresh new thinking to the world of motorhomes and combined with Knaus group's superior build quality this little motorhome will make a wonderful travelling companion for its next lucky owner.Starting with the chassis, those who know their VW group vehicles will understand the 6.1 Transporter chassis is the final model built solely by VW. This particular example is a 150BHP DSG equipped unit with premium Bluetooth infotainment system and generous base vehicle specification. This is aimed at a couple travelling in luxury with two belted seats and two sleeping places.The exterior dimensions are a very compact 5.9m long, 2.16m wide and 2.84m high with a gross vehicle weight of just 3200kg. With these dimensions you would expect fairly restricted internal space but the Knaus design team have done a wonderful job of utilising the internal space.Starting at the front you have the VW cab seats swivelling around effortlessly to create a lounge space that could actually accommodate six people if required. Plenty of storage space above the lounge/dinette and throughout the interior. The lounge area was originally fitted with a fixed table, this has been removed by the current owners to generate a more free-flowing interior but this can be easily refitted for the new owner. Either side of the van you have the washroom and the kitchen. The washroom is a very well executed smart bathroom with a swing wall creating a generous shower area. Great usable storage also exists in the washroom. Cassette toilet and sink are standard and complete this very capable washroom.The kitchen has a large compressor fridge which opens from the right and the left side, useful when you are outside of the van to grab a cold drink, a two burner gas hob and sink. Modern motorhome design is starting to move away from traditional cooking methods, smaller vans now regularly come without the traditional oven and grill facilities. In the additional specification below I will elaborate on this concept.The final piece of the interior jigsaw is a very impressive full height garage style locker at the rear. This is accessible both internally and externally and has a large adjustable shelf whilst also having a very usable space reaching right across to the other side of the van of the garage floor area.Standard specification of the 500 LT is excellent but the Pepper Edition adds a little extra. In this particular model you have a 27" Avtex TV, Oyster satellite, Thule awning, reverse camera, alarm, Truma diesel heating system, alloy wheels and stylish, low energy LED lighting throughout. There is an upgraded quality entrance door which has rather cool coat hooks, a wet umbrella holder and a Handly little shopping bag for the groceries... it's the little features that make all the difference in compact vans.In addition to the fantastic specification above the current owner has fitted high quality additional electronics to this van to make it very capable off grid. There is a 150Ah lithium battery, Victron 50a battery to battery charger and twin Renogy 115w solar panels (total 230w) with upgraded Victron charge controller. All your battery information will be available through the Victron apps so you will never again suffer battery anxiety. This upgraded 12 volt system brings the ability to introduce modern cooking facilities like an air fryer. This is fast becoming the cooking equipment of choice for off grid use.We have a great selection of pictures available, just give us a call and one of the team can talk you through this rather exciting little van. CALL TRACY ON 07469195025 TO ARRANGE A VIEWING. LOCTION ANTRIM. FINANCE AND 1 MONTHS FREE DRIVEAWAY INSURANCE AVAILABLE.

details.description: *Location is Sheffield*Welcome to the sale of this fantastic Swift Voyager 475. This superb 5 berth motorhome is based on the popular Ford Transit chassis and offers an incredibly versatile layout, making it an ideal choice for families or couples looking for a spacious and practical motorhome. With five travelling seats and five berths, the Voyager 475 provides plenty of flexibility for both touring and longer stays. The 475 features a 2.0 litre Ford EcoBlue diesel engine, with a manual 6 speed gearbox.Starting at the rear of the motorhome, you have the fantastic rear lounge which provides a huge amount of seating during the day and is flooded with natural light, making this a fantastic area to relax, socialise and enjoy your time away. The rear lounge can easily be converted into a very large and comfortable double bed at night, providing an excellent sleeping area for two adults. There is also plenty of storage throughout this area, with overhead lockers providing ample space for clothing and personal belongings.Moving towards the centre of the motorhome, we come to the kitchen area which is ideally positioned for easy access from both the lounge and front living area. The kitchen provides everything you need for preparing meals whilst away, including the gas hob, oven and sink with mixer tap, along with useful storage cupboards and worktop space. Opposite the kitchen is the spacious washroom, which incorporates a separate shower, wash basin, toilet and additional storage, giving you all the facilities you would expect from a much larger motorhome.Moving towards the front of the motorhome, we come to the versatile front dinette area. With the cab seats swivelled around, this creates a bright and sociable living space with seating for the whole family. The dinette also incorporates additional forward-facing travelling seats, meaning the Voyager 475 can comfortably accommodate five people when travelling. At night, the dinette can be converted into an additional single sleeping area, whilst above the cab is the excellent fixed Luton double bed. This overcab bed provides a generous sleeping area and is easily accessed using the supplied ladder.In the cab, the Voyager 475 benefits from the excellent Ford Transit driving environment, giving a comfortable and familiar driving experience. Depending on specification, features include a touchscreen infotainment system with Apple CarPlay/Android Auto, Bluetooth, radio, cruise control, cab air conditioning and reversing camera.Overall, the Swift Voyager 475 is an incredibly versatile 5 berth motorhome, offering a fantastic combination of living space, sleeping accommodation and practicality. With its spacious rear lounge, fixed overcab double bed, additional single bed, five travelling seats and well-equipped kitchen and washroom, it is perfectly suited to family adventures whilst still being an excellent option for couples wanting plenty of space.This motorhome will come with 1 months free driveaway insurance via Caravan Guard.

Motorhome Depot Worksop brings you a fantastic opportunity to own this 2023 Elddis Autoquest Evolution 196, a genuinely versatile 6-berth, 6-belt motorhome designed with family adventures in mind. With just 9,192 miles and 1 previous owner, this impressive Evolution combines the space you need for family touring with the convenience of a 3500kg chassis and 7.34m length.The clever layout makes this motorhome particularly flexible. During the day, the end lounge with opposing bench seats creates a spacious and sociable area for relaxing, while the centre dinette provides another comfortable living space. When it's time to settle down, both areas convert into double beds, complemented by the electric drop-down bed to create the full 6-berth sleeping capacity. With rear travel belts, swivel cab seats, USB points throughout, removable carpets and an additional fold-out dining table, there's plenty here to make everyday touring simple.The kitchen is ready for family-sized meals, with a Thetford oven and grill, microwave, 3-burner gas hob with an additional electric ring, and a Dometic fridge/freezer. The practical washroom includes a Thetford toilet, while heating and hot water ensure comfort whether you're touring in summer or heading away during the colder months.It's equally well equipped outside, with a wind-out canopy, reversing camera, bike rack, aerial, tracker and Whale BBQ point, alongside two keys. Behind the wheel, cab air conditioning, cruise control, a multifunction steering wheel and radio make longer journeys more comfortable, while the strong specification continues with a TV bracket in the lounge.With its low mileage, single previous owner and genuine 6-berth flexibility, the Evolution 196 is a fantastic choice for families who want the freedom to pack up, head off and make the most of their time together. Spacious, practical and ready for its next adventure.Did you know you can visit our Motorhome Depot Worksop retail forwcourt and browse motorhomes in person? Call our team today on 01909 286861 for further information or to arrange a viewing. All motorhomes come with FREE 31-day drive-away insurance, a new habitation check, and a comprehensive handover to give you complete peace of mind on the road.We welcome part exchanges and offer flexible finance options through our trusted partners (subject to status). 12 Month warranty included with options to upgrade at additional costs. All motorhomes come with a new habitation check and a comprehensive handover.We can also arrange upgrades including solar panels, refillable gas systems, lithium batteries, bike racks, tow bars, WiFi systems, reversing cameras, and wind-out awnings.Collection from the local railway station available — just let us know!Opening hours: Monday to Friday 9am–5pm, Saturday 10am–4pm, Sunday by appointment.
Please note, this vehicle is not a brokerage unit and as such means that it is compliant with the Consumer Rights Act 2015.

Chausson has built a reputation for being a true trailblazer in motorhome design, combining clever layouts, innovative features and stylish interiors. The 2019 Welcome 738 XLB is a fantastic example of this approach, offering spacious accommodation and everything you need for comfortable touring.

Designed with both practicality and comfort in mind, this 4 -berth motorhome provides a bright and welcoming living space, a well-equipped kitchen and an excellent rear bedroom. Bright, contemporary lounge with a forward-facing dinette, swivel cab seats and two additional travelling seatbelts. Electric drop-down bed above the lounge, providing a convenient additional sleeping area and making this a versatile 4-berth model. Well-equipped central kitchen featuring a hob, oven and large refrigerator with separate freezer. Spacious rear bedroom with a fantastic fixed island bed, offering easy access from both sides and a comfortable night's sleep. Modern washroom positioned at the rear, complete with a separate shower cubicle. Stylish contemporary interior with quality finishes throughout. Clever, spacious layout offering excellent comfort for longer trips and extended touring. The Welcome 738 XLB is particularly well suited to experienced motorhome owners looking for something a little more special, combining clever design, generous living space and a high level of equipment in one beautifully presented package. You can drive this vehicle on a standard driving licence. There are 2 additional seatbelts so 4 can travel in safety. For any further technical info please call us on 01227 733557.

Elddis Autoquest 196 2024 – Spacious Six-Berth Family Touring
This 2024 Elddis Autoquest 196 is a low-profile, six-berth motorhome on the dependable Fiat Ducato Euro 6E chassis, a strong option for larger families or groups who want genuine flexibility without a heavier vehicle. With six belted travel seats and three separate sleeping areas, it works as hard on the school run as on a fortnight away.
Electric Drop-Down Double Bed
Above the cab, an electrically operated double bed (1.85m x 1.42m) drops down at the touch of a button, giving two people a dedicated sleeping space that tucks away out of sight during the day.
Twin Lounge Areas
A rear lounge and a front dinette both convert into further double beds (2.08m x 1.47m and 2.08m x 1.09m), so the layout flexes between daytime living space and sleeping for six without complicated set-up.
Front Dinette with Isofix Points
Seating four with built-in Isofix points, the front dinette is a practical spot for younger passengers to travel safely, while doubling as a sociable dining area once parked up.
Well-Equipped Kitchen
A full cooker, a decent-sized fridge and generous worktop space mean there is real scope for proper home cooking, rather than a compact camping set-up.
Spacious Washroom
The washroom offers a modern feel with enough room to use comfortably, staying practical for everyday touring rather than feeling cramped.
Whale Dual-Fuel Heating
Dual-fuel heating keeps the cabin warm whether off-grid or hooked up, adding useful flexibility for touring outside the height of summer.
Fiat Ducato Base
A 6-speed manual gearbox comes as standard, with an automatic available as an option, so buyers can choose the driving experience that suits them.
With six travel seats, three separate sleeping areas and a well thought-out kitchen and washroom, the Autoquest 196 suits larger families or groups after a genuinely flexible motorhome for touring, without asking anyone to compromise on comfort.

RAC Approved used Chausson 720 for sale from AMC Motorhomes. Comes minimum 9 Month MOT, Habitation service, Mechanical Service, Full Interior & Exterior Valet, Full Demonstration On Collection, Full HPI Certification and 6 Month warranty. AMC Motorhomes is the UK's only RAC Recommended used motorhome dealership. Finance available, and part exchange welcome. https://www.amcmotorcaravans.co.uk/used/ 01323 449146
Our 2020 Chausson 720 is a versatile, low-profile, family-friendly motorhome known for its innovative Smart Lounge and flexible 6-berth layout, all within a standard car license weight limit (3,500 kg). It offers comfortable daytime living and multiple sleeping configurations at night!
LOUNGE
This smart, innovative feature consists of two inward-facing side sofas in the front lounge area. While static, these benches conceal two forward-facing, belted travel seats for passengers during transit.
SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS
The motorhome can sleep up to six people across three distinct areas. A large double bed (approx. 160 x 200 cm) electrically lowers from the ceiling above the lounge. The rear features fixed single bunk beds. The top bunk can be raised electrically when not in use, and the bottom bunk can also be folded up to increase garage space. The lounge area also converts into an additional single or double bed.
WASHROOM
A full-width washroom is located at the rear, featuring a separate shower cubicle,electric flush cassette toilet, and wash basin.
KITCHEN
The kitchen includes a two-burner gas hob, an electric hot plate, an oven/grill, sink and a large fridge/freezer.
STORAGE
The storage system is highly flexible; by raising the lower rear bunk bed, a generous, height-adjustable garage space is created for larger items like bikes or outdoor gear, accessible from both inside and outside.
Overall, the 2020 Chausson 720 is highly regarded for being an extremely versatile motorhome that cleverly maximizes internal space for families, offering a balance of comfortable living areas and practical storage solutions.

The Approved Workshop Scheme (AWS) is the UK’s leading standard for motorhome and caravan servicing. Accredited workshops must meet strict requirements for technician training, equipment, safety and workmanship.
