we are proud to present this 2025 Auto-Trail V-Line 610 SE - 2 Berth, 2 Belt, Rear Lounge Compact Motorhome
For sale is this superb 2025 Auto-Trail V-Line 610 SE, a premium motorhome combining excellent road handling with a spacious and luxurious interior.
Built on the Fiat Ducato chassis, the V-Line 610 SE is just under 6 metres long, making it an ideal choice for touring, weekends away and longer European adventures while remaining easy to drive and manoeuvre.
This particular example benefits from several desirable upgrades, most notably the  Panoview panoramic roof, a 1,595 factory-fitted option, together with leisure battery and a  Votronic split charger. Combined with the solar panel and underslung LPG gas tank.
The leisure battery, split charger, solar panel and onboard LPG gas tank enable off-grid camping for days on end, giving you the freedom to spend longer away from campsites without compromising on comfort.
The Panoview is a particularly attractive feature, flooding the cab and living area with natural light and creating a brighter, more spacious and open feel to the interior.
The standout feature of the V-Line 610 SE is its impressive rear lounge, providing a bright, comfortable living space with excellent views through the rear doors. The lounge converts easily into a generous double bed, making this a highly practical 2-berth motorhome, alternatively you can use as 2 x single beds.
The interior has a contemporary, high-quality finish with clever use of space, plenty of storage and a well-equipped kitchen and washroom. The V-Line SE also benefits from modern touring technology and excellent off-grid capability.
The vehicle is still covered by the just under 2 years manufacturer's warranty, providing additional peace of mind to the next owner. This can be extended by utilising our ULS Premium Protect Package.
Whether you're looking for a stylish touring van, an easy-to-drive weekend camper or a comfortable vehicle for extended adventures, the V-Line 610 SE offers an excellent combination of comfort, practicality and compact dimensions.

McLouis Fusion 330 – 2024 Motorhome
If you want a compact motorhome that doesn't feel cramped, this 2024 McLouis Fusion 330 is well worth a look. It's a used motorhome from our used motorhomes range, built on the Fiat Ducato with the familiar 2.2 diesel engine and a 6-speed manual gearbox. It was first registered on 28 June 2024 and has just 1,841 miles on the clock.
What makes the Fusion range a bit different is that it's built in Italy but designed to UK specification in partnership with Auto-Sleepers, so the habitation door sits on the UK nearside where you'd expect it. That's a proper practical touch on a UK site, and it isn't something you get on every continental-built motorhome.
At roughly 6.49 metres long and 2.35 metres wide, it's easy to park, fuel up and slot onto a pitch, yet you still get a proper lounge and a drop-down bed. At 3,500kg MTPLM, this one is designed to be driven on a standard UK license, though as always it's worth checking your own entitlement.
features: Exterior & Technical Highlights  This motorhome is on 2.2 diesel Fiat power, has alloy wheels, and comes with a Fiamma awning. A roof-mounted solar panel is fitted. Outside, you'll find an external 230v hook-up socket, a fresh water filler, a separate diesel filler, and a gas locker with a refillable gas cylinder. The rear garage is accessed via an external hatch.  If you're comparing options, take a look at our other used motorhomes too.

Interior Highlights  Bedroom: An electric drop-down bed comes down from the ceiling when you need it and tucks away when you don't. The lowered bed and its wall switch are both shown in the photos.  Washroom: The washroom has a cassette toilet, a washbasin with a mirror and a wall cupboard. There's a separate shower area with its own tray, a rail and a shower screen. A roof light gives you natural light.  Lounge: The rear lounge is a U-shaped seating area with a pedestal table that folds down to a good size. It has cream upholstery with plum accents, and there's storage above and around it.  Kitchen: The kitchen has a round stainless steel sink with a mixer tap, a hob and a tall black fridge. Overhead lockers and drawers give you decent storage for the size of the vehicle.  Technology: A Truma control panel is fitted for the heating, and there's a separate habitation control panel. In the cab you get a touchscreen radio, USB and 12v sockets, and a digital dash display.

What Owners Love About The McLouis Fusion 330 Built to UK specification, with the habitation door on the nearside A proper rear U-shaped lounge, so there's somewhere comfortable to sit on a wet day An electric drop-down bed, so the lounge stays a lounge in the daytime Roof-mounted solar to help keep the leisure battery topped up on site A rear garage with an external hatch for chairs, hoses and cables

The Kia PV5 is one of the most talked-about compact electric vans to be launched in recent years—and it is easy to see why.

This 2026 Knaus Vansation 500 MQ is a 3-berth coachbuilt motorhome on a VW chassis, with four belted travel seats for the whole family. With just 7,831 miles and one registered keeper, it suits a first-time buyer or an experienced tourer after a well-equipped, low-line van that's easy to live with.

Heating and Hot Water

ROLLER TEAM KRONOS COMPACT 590 AUTOMATIC – SPACE MEETS FREEDOM
Automatic | Ford Transit 2.0L 165BHP | 4 Berth | 4 Seatbelts | 3,500KG | 5.99m | Wind-Out Awning | Cab Blinds | 4-Bike Rack
If you like the idea of a proper 4-berth motorhome but don't fancy driving something that feels like a bus, the Roller Team Kronos Compact 590 deserves your attention.
This clever little low-profile motorhome takes the functionality of a coachbuilt and squeezes it into a remarkably compact 5.99m footprint. At just 2.15m wide, it is designed to be easy to manoeuvre, easy to park and, most importantly, enjoyable to drive. Roller Team themselves describe the Kronos Compact as combining the functionality of a motorhome with the manoeuvrability of a campervan.
And this particular example adds something rather special to the equation...
AUTOMATIC. 165BHP. READY TO GO.
Underneath is the Ford Transit 2.0-litre 165BHP, upgraded with the 8-speed automatic gearbox.
That means relaxed cruising on the motorway, effortless progress through traffic and none of the clutch-and-gear routine when you're negotiating busy towns or steep holiday destinations.
The Driver's Pack adds the sort of details that make this Kronos feel a little more special too – including high-series headlamps with static bending, Moondust Silver cab, 16" alloy wheels, locking glovebox, Trend interior accents and colour-coded bumpers and side mouldings.
It's a very smart combination of Ford's familiar driving environment and Roller Team's compact motorhome design.
FOUR BERTH. FOUR SEATBELTS. ONE VERY CLEVER LAYOUT.
The Kronos 590 is proof that you don't necessarily need seven metres of motorhome to have genuine family-friendly flexibility.
The front lounge provides a comfortable place to sit, dine and relax, with the cab seats swivelling into the living area. When bedtime arrives, the drop-down bed makes the transformation remarkably simple, while the dinette can also convert into a bed – giving you up to four berths.
With four travelling seats and four berths, it is equally at home as a couples' motorhome...

• Smooth and comfortable drive
The 7-speed automatic gearbox adds a real layer of comfort and ease — ideal if you’re doing long journeys, towing, or want a stress-free drive through towns. The gearbox shifts smoothly, making the van feel more like a grand tourer than a coachbuilt motorhome. For many owners this makes a huge difference compared to manual vans, especially on longer trips or frequent motorway driving.
• Premium-spec Frontier lineup — luxury & space
As part of the Frontier range, the Comanche S has a high-end specification: generous interior space, quality finishes, clever layout and plenty of storage. That means it delivers a proper “home away from home” feel, not just a basic campervan. The S model — combined with the auto gearbox — makes the van function as a high-end touring base, which suits families or couples wanting comfort without hassle.
• Versatile layout and living comfort
Comanche S offers a flexible living layout: sleeping, dining, and socialising areas are well thought-out — giving you the feel of a comfortable holiday home on wheels. The build quality, space, and convenience make it suitable not just for short holidays but for longer trips, touring Europe, or full-on motorhome lifestyle.
• Easier driving appeal
For drivers who may find a manual gearbox tiresome after a long drive, or who tow a trailer / car / bike rack, the auto offers real benefits: smoother start-stop in traffic, easier overtaking, less clutch stress. It broadens the appeal — someone who might be nervous about driving a long motorhome can feel more confident behind the wheel.

The 2026 Elddis Whirlwind GT 155 is a contemporary, low-profile coachbuilt motorhome designed for families and couples who want space, style, and practicality without compromising on handling. With its well-designed interior and excellent use of space this is an ideal choice for comfortable touring and extended trips.

details.description: Motorhome Depot Burnley are delighted to present this 2023 Roller Team T-Line 740, an exceptionally well-presented 4 berth, 4 belted motorhome built on the Fiat Ducato chassis with manual transmission.  Having covered just 13,977 miles, this sought after model offers one of Roller Team's most popular layouts, combining a spacious rear bedroom with a bright, modern living area that is equally suited to couples or families. Despite its generous size and impressive specification, it has a Gross Vehicle Weight of just 3,500kg, meaning it can be driven on a standard UK driving licence.  The rear of the motorhome is home to the comfortable fixed island bed, allowing the bedroom to remain permanently made up and ready for use. Beneath the bed is a large rear garage, providing excellent storage for bikes, outdoor furniture and everything needed for extended touring. During the day, the central living area provides a welcoming space to relax, while the electrically operated drop down double bed lowers effortlessly over the lounge, providing comfortable sleeping accommodation for four without the need to convert the seating area.  Separating the bedroom from the living area is one of the T-Line 740's standout features, the full width island washroom, creating a private rear suite. The washroom includes a separate shower cubicle, toilet and vanity area, providing all the comfort and convenience of home wherever your travels take you.  The front lounge is bright and airy thanks to the large panoramic skylight, with both captain's chairs swivelling to create a comfortable and sociable seating area around the dinette. Roller Team's contemporary cabinetry and light upholstery give the interior a spacious, modern feel throughout.  The central kitchen has been thoughtfully designed with generous preparation space and excellent storage, a 3 hob gas burner, oven/grill and large fridge/freezer, making it ideal whether you're preparing a quick lunch or cooking a full evening meal after a day exploring.  This particular example also benefits from two desirable upgrades. The addition of Truma habitation air conditioning keeps the living area cool and comfortable during warmer weather, while the premium Duvalay mattress provides an even more restful night's sleep.  With its low mileage, popular layout and excellent overall condition, this T-Line 740 is ready for its next owners to enjoy immediately. It also benefits from an MOT valid until May 2027, together with recent engine and habitation services, giving added confidence that it is prepared and ready for its next adventure.  Finance, part exchange and extended warranty options are available through Motorhome Depot, together with one month's free insurance for added peace of mind.

The Roller Team Zefiro 696 is the epitome of modern motorhome luxury, designed for those who crave adventure without compromising on comfort. With its sleek Italian styling and thoughtfully crafted interior, it offers a seamless blend of practicality and elegance. At the heart of the layout is a spacious rear island bed, providing a restful retreat after a day on the road. An innovative electric drop-down double bed adds extra sleeping space without encroaching on the living area, making it ideal for couples or families.
Inside, the fully equipped kitchen features a three-burner hob, oven/grill, and a large fridge/freezer, allowing you to prepare meals with ease wherever you are. The bathroom is equally impressive, boasting a separate shower cubicle and a cassette toilet, ensuring all the comforts of home are always within reach.
Storage throughout the Zefiro 696 is cleverly integrated to keep your living space tidy and organized. Overhead lockers run the length of the lounge and bedroom areas, offering ample room for clothing, bedding, and travel essentials. Under-bed compartments and wardrobe space provide additional capacity for bulkier items. Whether you're packing for a weekend getaway or an extended tour, the Zefiro 696 makes it easy to travel light—or not.
Built on a reliable Ford Transit chassis, the Zefiro 696 is powered by a capable 130bhp engine and comes with cruise control and cab air conditioning for a smooth and enjoyable drive. The Truma heating system ensures you're comfortable in all seasons, while ambient LED lighting, USB ports, and a TV bracket provide entertainment and convenience on the go.
With generous garage space for all your gear and a layout that maximizes both storage and living comfort, the Zefiro 696 is more than just a motorhome—it's your passport to freedom and unforgettable journeys

The sink comes with a removable drainer as well as a chopping board and, opposite, the 139-litre auto  energy selection fridge is one of the latest type with the door that opens from either side.
There’s a large cupboard under the sink and concealed here is a cutlery drawer.
French bed layout with access to the bed, which here measures 1.90m by 1.25m max.
The mattress lifts on gas struts to reveal a large area of uninterrupted storage and the bed has corner shelves and reading lights.

details.description:
The Elddis Accordo 120 is a compact yet highly practical coachbuilt motorhome designed to offer comfortable touring with a smart use of space and a bright, open feel.
At the rear, it features a spacious lounge with two opposing bench seats, creating a relaxing and versatile living area. Large windows on three aspects provide excellent natural light and great panoramic views, making the space feel airy and open whether parked up or on site. This lounge converts easily into a good-sized sleeping area, offering flexibility between day and night use.
The kitchen is well equipped with everything needed for life on the road, including a microwave, grill, oven, and gas hobs. Thoughtful storage throughout ensures essentials are kept neatly organised and within easy reach.
To the rear side, there is a well-designed bathroom with shower, toilet, and washbasin, offering privacy and convenience for longer trips.
This model comes well specified with solar panels for off-grid capability, a TV aerial, alloy wheels, and a bike rack for carrying extra leisure gear. It also benefits from an external BBQ point, making outdoor cooking simple and convenient when staying on site.
Overall, the Accordo 120 combines a bright rear lounge layout, strong specification, and compact dimensions to deliver a comfortable and versatile touring motorhome.

The Elddis Accordo 105 is a compact coachbuilt motorhome under 6 metres in length, designed for easy driving without compromising on comfort. Ideal for couples, it offers a smart and practical layout with excellent use of space throughout.
At the front, the lounge features two long, opposing bench seats, creating a bright and sociable area for relaxing or dining. This space converts into a good-sized double bed, making it versatile for both day and night use.
The kitchen is well equipped with a microwave, grill, oven, and gas hobs, providing everything needed for cooking on the road. Storage is thoughtfully integrated, making it suitable for longer trips.
To the rear, there is a spacious bathroom with a shower, toilet, and washbasin, offering comfort and privacy rarely found in a motorhome of this size.
This example comes with a great specification including solar panels, TV aerial, alloy wheels, BBQ point, external 240V socket, winter pack for all-season use, reversing camera, and a bike rack.
Overall, the Accordo 105 combines compact dimensions with a well-designed interior and desirable extras, making it a popular choice for comfortable touring.

• Smooth and comfortable drive
The 7-speed automatic gearbox adds a real layer of comfort and ease — ideal if you’re doing long journeys, towing, or want a stress-free drive through towns. The gearbox shifts smoothly, making the van feel more like a grand tourer than a coachbuilt motorhome. For many owners this makes a huge difference compared to manual vans, especially on longer trips or frequent motorway driving.
• Premium-spec Frontier lineup — luxury & space
As part of the Frontier range, the Comanche S has a high-end specification: generous interior space, quality finishes, clever layout and plenty of storage. That means it delivers a proper “home away from home” feel, not just a basic campervan. The S model — combined with the auto gearbox — makes the van function as a high-end touring base, which suits families or couples wanting comfort without hassle.
• Versatile layout and living comfort
Comanche S offers a flexible living layout: sleeping, dining, and socialising areas are well thought-out — giving you the feel of a comfortable holiday home on wheels. The build quality, space, and convenience make it suitable not just for short holidays but for longer trips, touring Europe, or full-on motorhome lifestyle.
• Easier driving appeal
For drivers who may find a manual gearbox tiresome after a long drive, or who tow a trailer / car / bike rack, the auto offers real benefits: smoother start-stop in traffic, easier overtaking, less clutch stress. It broadens the appeal — someone who might be nervous about driving a long motorhome can feel more confident behind the wheel.

2020 Auto-Sleeper Warwick Duo MQ – Special Edition Campervan for Sale in Essex
Available now at Cranham Leisuresales, this 2020 Auto-Sleeper Warwick Duo MQ is a rare special edition built on the Fiat Ducato chassis and fitted with a 9-speed automatic gearbox. With just 6,170 miles recorded, it’s a beautifully maintained example of Auto-Sleeper’s class-leading two-berth campervan.
The Warwick Duo MQ is one of the most sought-after layouts in the Auto-Sleeper range, offering a spacious rear lounge that quickly converts into either two single beds or a large double bed. Its clever design provides a generous open-plan living area while maintaining the practicality and drivability of a panel van conversion.
This MQ edition benefits from a number of premium factory and special-order features, including Truma habitation air conditioning and air-ride suspension, ensuring every journey is smooth, quiet, and comfortable. Throughout, Auto-Sleeper’s trademark build quality is evident — with solid cabinetry, LED lighting, and clever storage solutions that make the most of every inch of space.
Kitchen
The fully equipped kitchen is designed for convenience and includes a full oven and grill, 3-burner gas hob, microwave, stainless steel sink, and a Dometic fridge with freezer compartment. Ample worktop space and storage cupboards make it easy to prepare meals on the move, while the external BBQ point allows for outdoor cooking when the weather’s right.
Washroom
A compact but fully featured washroom includes a shower, electric flush toilet, wash basin, and mirrored vanity unit. The space is practical and easy to maintain, ideal for comfortable touring without compromise.
Exterior & Mechanical Features

This Warwick Duo MQ Special Edition offers the perfect blend of luxury, comfort, and practicality in a compact two-berth campervan. The Chausson S514 is a compact low-profile motorhome designed to deliver the comfort and insulation of a full-size coach built, in a much more manageable, van-like size. At just 5.99m long and 2.10m wide, it’s easy to drive, park and tour across the UK and Europe without compromising on living space.
Built on the reliable Ford Transit chassis, the S514 combines smooth driving performance with modern safety technology and excellent fuel efficiency.  Inside, it offers a clever and practical layout ideal for couples or small families, with a comfortable rear sleeping area, a bright lounge with swivel cab seats, and a fully equipped kitchen and washroom.
Despite its compact footprint, the S514 provides impressive space and usability, with up to 3 berths and 4 travelling seats, making it a versatile all-rounder for both short breaks and longer adventures.
Key features
Ford Transit 2.0L engine (165bhp) with automatic gearbox
Compact 5.99m length – easy to manoeuvre
Slimline 2.10m width – ideal for UK roads
Rear bed with additional dinette conversion
Bright lounge with swivel captain seats
Fully equipped kitchen and washroom
Panoramic skylight and modern interior styling
Excellent storage including rear garage space
The S514 is perfect for those wanting a smaller motorhome without sacrificing comfort, offering the ideal balance of practicality, style, and value.

Space & flexibility: Multiple living, sleeping, and working configurations – excellent for families, couples, or remote work.

details.description: The 2026 Auto-Trail F-Line F60 is a motorhome that delivers a true home-from-home experience wherever you travel. At just under six metres long, it’s compact and easy to drive, making manoeuvring and parking simple, while still offering a bright, spacious interior. Its sleek low-profile design ensures smooth driving and a modern look that stands out on the road. Inside, natural light floods the living space through a large panoramic skylight and wide windows, creating a calm, welcoming atmosphere. The lounge features two comfortable facing sofas that convert into a double bed, providing a relaxing space by day and a cosy sleeping area at night. The fully equipped kitchen makes cooking on the road effortless, with a gas hob, grill oven, and a large fridge freezer for storing fresh food and drinks. Whether it’s a quick breakfast or a relaxed evening meal, it’s designed for real home-style living. At the rear, the spacious en-suite bathroom includes a walk-in shower, large mirror, and practical storage. A double-door wardrobe and smart storage solutions throughout help keep everything organised and clutter-free. Built for modern travel, the F60 includes a gas BBQ point, solar panels for off-grid use, TV aerial, USB ports, blackout blinds, flyscreen door, and removable carpets—everything you need for comfort and flexibility on the road. Driving is equally refined, with features such as a reversing camera, rain-sensing wipers, heated windscreen, automatic headlights, front fog lamps, and cab air conditioning. Built on a 3500kg chassis, it remains licence-friendly while offering confidence and freedom on every journey.

This 2022 Adria Coral Plus 670 SL is a low mileage motorhome finished in white, built on the Fiat Ducato 3,850kg chassis with 10,644 miles recorded from two owners. Featuring an end bedroom with a fixed double bed, this well appointed model sleeps up to three across five belted travel seats, making it an ideal choice for couples or small families seeking comfort and practicality on the road.
The cab is fitted with a 6-speed manual gearbox, cabin air conditioning, a reversing camera and height-adjusting, swivelling driver and passenger seats, allowing the front seats to turn and become part of the living space once parked. A touchscreen infotainment system completes a well equipped driving environment.
Inside, the living area is finished with comfortable seating in half leather upholstery, offering a relaxed space to unwind, with a TV fitted for evenings spent at rest after a day of touring.
The kitchen is well equipped with a 3-ring gas burner hob, a gas oven with grill and a full size fridge freezer, providing everything needed for home comforts while away. A separate bathroom and shower add further practicality for longer stays.
A second TV is fitted in the bedroom area for added comfort, and twin 11kg gas lockers ensure a generous supply for cooking and heating throughout your travels.
Externally, the motorhome benefits from a large scooter garage, ideal for storing bikes or outdoor equipment, along with a Thule Omnistor awning for shaded outdoor living wherever you pitch up.

With its compact layout, it offers excellent manoeuvrability in tight spaces while travelling in comfort. Its 140 hp engine ensures a pleasant driving experience, and the bright, welcoming living areas are cleverly arranged to optimise storage space and interior circulation.

This layout maximizes the available space to meet all your storage needs while traveling.

Bürstner Lyseo Harmony 644G – 2024 Motorhome
The Lyseo TD Harmony Line 644G solves the usual trade-off of a rear-lounge motorhome — normally you get the sociable U-shaped seating or you get a proper garage, not both. Bürstner's layout gives you both within a compact 6.99m footprint: a genuinely spacious rear lounge with windows on three sides for a bright, open feel, sitting above a full-height rear garage with dual-sided access, ideal for bikes or bulky touring kit.
At night, an electric bed lowers from the ceiling above the lounge at the push of a button — no nightly cushion-shuffling required — while the seating below converts to a second double for the full 4-berth configuration. The washroom spans the full width of the motorhome just behind the cab, with a separate shower cubicle on one side and a cassette toilet and washbasin on the other; the toilet door swings across to close off the cab entirely, creating a private dressing room. Bürstner's Thermo-Floor double-floor construction keeps the freshwater plumbing protected and the cabin genuinely warm underfoot for year-round touring.
Built on a Fiat Ducato base with a diesel engine and an automatic transmission, this pre-owned 2024 example comes fitted with a Thule Omnistor awning with integrated LED lighting and a rear-mounted cycle carrier. You can compare it against the rest of our used motorhomes, and research this motorhome's history on the CRiS website using the registration below.

Wake up somewhere different, open the blinds and start the day with the freedom to decide where the road takes you next. The 2024 Chausson Titanium Ultimate 777 GA is made for those who want more from their time away, combining stylish accommodation, genuine comfort and the freedom to travel without having to plan every detail.

The front lounge becomes a welcoming social space when you're parked, with the swivel cab seats helping create a comfortable area for relaxing, enjoying a meal or unwinding with a drink after a day out.
At the rear, the fixed single beds provide a dedicated bedroom that is ready whenever you are. It's a layout that makes longer trips particularly enjoyable, giving everyone a little more space and privacy.

A full oven, gas hob, electric hotplate and fridge freezer give you the flexibility to eat exactly how you want, while the onboard water tank adds convenience when you're staying away from home comforts.
The separate washroom brings another level of independence to your travels, with a dedicated shower and cassette toilet allowing you to take everything you need with you. Back at the pitch, the awning creates an outdoor living area where you can sit back and enjoy the surroundings, while the external BBQ point is perfect for relaxed evenings outside.

LOUNGE/DINETTE
Stepping inside of this Sunlight i695 you come straight into the beautiful and inviting lounge space. This area at the front of the motorhome is spacious ad great for etertainment as there is room for everyone to socialise.
BEDROOM
The first of the sleeping arrangements can be found at the front of the vehicle which is a huge drop down bed. The bed lowers over the top of the lounge seating area. This is great for space saving a when not in use, the bed can be stored away easily. The other sleeping arrangement is a huge island bed. This is a double which sleeps two people very comfortably and can be found at the rear of the motorhome. A positive of having an island bed is that it can be accessed from both sides of the bed!
KITCHEN
The kitchen area is equipped nicely with everything you could possibly need while away on your camping trips. This includes a 3-burner gas hob, oven, grill, fridge/freezer and a sink. As well as all of these kitchen appliances there is also plenty of worktop space for prepping and serving all your meals on and also cupboard spaces for storage purposes. Storage is a very important part of any motorhome experience and luckily our Sunlight i695 provides just that, not only throughout the kitchen but the entire motorhome.
THE OUTSIDE
On the subject of storage, ifyou take a look at the exterior part of the motorhome you will be amazed at how much storage this vehicle really has to offer. The garage is large with a huge door meaning bikes and camping equipment such as chairs/tables etc can be stored away with ease. If this is not enough, there is even a rear storage box attatched to the back of the vehicle for even more storage!
BATHROOM
The washroom in any motorhome is small for size however in our beautiful Sunlight i695 the bathroom suit is spread into two. On the left hand side is the electric flush cassette toilet and wash basin with a door closingthem off for privacy. And on the right hand side, located is the seperate shower which is not small in size at the slightest. The washroom in this vehicle really makes the most of all the space there is!
What a fantastic family friendly motorhome!

The 2026 Elddis Signature 196 is a brand-new motorhome that combines modern style, smart design, and practical comfort. Built on the latest Fiat Ducato chassis, it features a 2.2-litre 140 BHP engine with a smooth automatic gearbox, making it effortless to drive whether you’re on the motorway or winding through narrow country lanes. 2026 Pilote Evidence V600G
To offer you the best without compromise, Pilote introduces the Évidence editions, fully equipped camper vans ready for your journey. Comfortable and functional vehicles, fitted as standard with the most sought-after features by our passionate camper enthusiasts. The V600G Évidence is specially engineered for van adventurers seeking the perfect blend of compactness and comfort. With its compact layout, it offers excellent manoeuvrability in tight spaces while travelling in comfort. Its 140 hp engine ensures a pleasant driving experience, and the bright, welcoming living areas are cleverly arranged to optimise storage space and interior circulation.
The converted van Pilote V600G offers a functional kitchen with five compartmentalized drawers and an integrated garbage bin, allowing for organized and convenient storage. Its large living area comfortably accommodates up to four people, providing a friendly space to relax and socialize. Additionally, the shower space is spacious, offering comfort and convenience for daily hygiene. The van also features a practical wardrobe for clothing storage. Lastly, the garage bed is equipped with a comfortable mattress and a slatted base, ensuring restful sleep for a good night's rest.
The Lounge -
With the V600G, you'll have a large saloon area where 4 people can sit comfortably, thanks to the wide rear bench seat and two cabin seats. It's also pre-equipped with wiring for a satellite dish and television. To ensure plenty of light inside, the roof is fitted with a 62x42cm panoramic sunroof with blackout and flyscreen.
The Kitchen -
The V600G's galley is designed to allow you to cook with ease. It is equipped with 5 drawers with end-of-travel brakes and an overhead cabinet. The hob has a 2-burner piezo ignition system, and a sink cover extends the work surface, as does the extension at the end of the cabinet.
The Bedroom -
The V600G has a garage bed with a comfort mattress and slatted base. The bed measures 135 x 194 cm. Numerous overhead cupboards on either side of the bed conceal USB ports. Under the bed, there's a large storage compartment for all your essentials and easy access to the gas compartment and fresh water tank.
The Bathroom -
The V600G is equipped with a 3in1 shower room featuring clever solutions for comfortable use. This 790×860 cm space is fitted with a slide-mounted Thetford toilet and a retractable washbasin, leaving a large shower area. A 280×280 skylight provides good ventilation.
The Garage -
The storage area of the Pilote V600G is built under a transverse garage bed, offering a spacious, accessible, and flexible compartment. This generous volume allows for easy storage of bulky equipment while maintaining convenient access to the gas compartment and fresh water tank. This layout maximizes the available space to meet all your storage needs while traveling.

Reversing sensors and reversing camera.  Two new 105 Ah leisure batteries September 2025. 150W Solar panel.
The lounge features two side-facing bench seats with an adjustable table between, providing a spacious living and dining area for 6 people.  Oversize (160 cm wide)  drop-down bed.  2 futher beds can be made up below, when in semi-dropped down mode. 2 foldaway travel seats provde belted travel for 4 people.
The kitchen area has excellent storage areas and features a full oven, with 2 gas hobs and one electric. Large 3-way Fridge with separate freezer above.  The bathroom area is separated from the lounge by a tambour privacy door. It features a separate shower opposite a Thetford WC and a ceramic wash-hand basin  -  which was retrofitted to replace the original rather poor factory fit unit.
Concertina blinds to windscreen and front side windows.  Habitation area windows are Seitz double glazed with concertina blinds and fly screens.
Space heating is diesel Webasto blown air. Water heating is electric and/or gas. 11 kg Gaslow tank fitted.
This model features a large garage which easily accommodates 2 bicycles and features a very convenient and useful rear door (which is absent on later models) as well as doors on each side - the nearside door being full height and featuring useful shelving at high level.
The area above the garage provides a huge internal storage area, with hanging space, large storage areas either side and retro-fitted bungee system to the rear shelving as featured on later 640 models.
 Fresh water tank is 100 litres, with a lagged waste water tank of 75 litres with retrofit level gauge. External shower point.

This is remarkably well priced and needs to be viewed to be appreciated . It has the late model exterior and interior styling with more neutral grey upholstery and light wood vinyl flooring under the removable carpets.

It has a Truma combi heater and water heater which runs on both 240v electric and LPG. All opening windows and rooflights have concertina blackout blinds and fly screens including a flyscreen on the habitation door with Remis blinds on the cab windows.

AVT Campers are pleased to offer for sale this 2022/72 Volkswagen Transporter Highline T6.1 AVT Campervan. Designed for comfort, style, and adventure, this campervan is fully equipped. The van itself is a 2022/72 Volkswagen T6.1 T28 Highline, with a 6 speed gearbox with only 27,236 miles from new. The interior has been insulated and carpeted before our bespoke kitchen is fitted. We have found this layout will offer the perfect balance between form and function. The kitchen is complete with a sink and double gas hob, a microwave, fridge freezer, wireless phone charger, power sockets and plenty of energy efficient LED lights. You will also notice the huge amount of storage on offer. There is also a gas locker tucked away near the BBQ gas point. The front double seat can swivel to face into the van and make a spacious dining area when the stowable table is in place.

Sometimes the right motorhome isn't the biggest one. It's the one that gives you everything you need to simply pack your bags and go.
Heart of England Motorhomes are delighted to offer this beautifully presented 2017 (66) Swift Bolero 612EK, with just one owner from new and an exceptionally low 7,800 miles.
Finished with a striking black cab, this two-berth Bolero offers a lovely balance of comfort, practicality and touring appeal. The bright front lounge provides a welcoming space to relax during the day before converting into a comfortable double bed at night.
The well-equipped kitchen features a gas and electric hob, while the spacious rear washroom gives you the convenience and privacy you'd appreciate when spending time away from home.
One of the standout features is the highly regarded Alde wet central heating system, providing quiet, even warmth throughout the motorhome, including the wardrobe and bathroom. It's a particularly welcome feature when touring during the cooler months.
The specification continues outside with alloy wheels, cab air conditioning, sun canopy awning, solar panel, twin reversing camera, bike rack, TV aerial, Remis cab blinds and an external BBQ point.
With its one-owner history, exceptionally low mileage and striking black cab, this Swift Bolero 612EK is a particularly appealing example. Finding a one-owner Bolero with fewer than 8,000 miles is becoming increasingly rare, making this a fantastic opportunity to own a beautifully cared-for motorhome that's ready to be enjoyed.
If you'd like any further information or would like to arrange a viewing, please get in touch. We're always happy to talk through the vehicle and help you decide whether it's the right motorhome for you.

At the rear, the twin fixed single beds create a calm, easy space to unwind, with storage tucked everywhere you’d expect and a few places you wouldn’t, making long trips feel effortless.
Why buy Auto‑Trail? Because their heritage runs deep. Auto‑Trail’s legacy is built on decades of British craftsmanship, touring know‑how and a commitment to making motorhomes that feel like a proper home on wheels. The Imala range carries that tradition proudly — dependable, beautifully thought‑out and designed for people who want to get out there and live the touring life without compromise.
